# DSH Plugins — DeepSeek Harness 社区插件

面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的四个 Web 插件：**MCP 连接管理**、**Skills 管理**、**敏感信息脱敏** 和 **渗透测试安全清单**，全部搬进设置页，纯本地运行、无任何外部上传。

## 插件一览

| 插件 | 设置入口 | 能力 |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-mcp-panel](./dsh-mcp-panel/) | **MCP 连接** | 查看所有 MCP 服务器（托管 + profile 配置行）、连接状态与工具数；新增/编辑/删除；托管配置写入 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 并热重载 |
| [dsh-skill-panel](./dsh-skill-panel/) | **Skills** | 查看全部本地/内置 skill，搜索、来源过滤、SKILL.md 预览、文件清单、**打开文件夹**；导出单个/选中/全部为 ZIP（含 `_manifest.json`） |
| [dsh-sensitive-mask](./dsh-sensitive-mask/) | **脱敏显示** | 发往模型前按正则/字面量脱敏（占位符 / 部分隐藏 / 固定文本，全局默认 + 单规则覆盖，头尾位数可配）；仅占位符会在工具执行前还原；命中写本地 JSONL 日志（默认不存原文） |
| [dsh-sec-checklist](./dsh-sec-checklist/) | **安全清单** | 渗透测试检查清单：内置 6 分类 36 项 + 自定义；项目/授权/范围/测试账号本机保存；勾选要调用的渗透 skill；保存后注册运行时技能 `security-checklist` 供 AI 加载；内置 Playbook 与 Yakit MCP 工具对照 |

四个插件都是 **host 半 + web client 半** 的结构，遵循 DSH 官方插件形态：

- `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`；
- host 半通过 `ctx.inject(['webServer'])` 挂同源 HTTP 路由；
- client 半注册 `settings.section` 面板，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 懒加载。

## Skills

| Skill | 作用 |
|---|---|
| [plan-gate](./skills/plan-gate/) | 首个需求先出「实施方案 + 涉及文件清单」再请求确认的闸门；确认后执行，**同一需求只做一次** |

安装（全局技能目录）：把 `skills/plan-gate` 复制到 `<AGENTS_HOME>/skills/plan-gate`（Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\plan-gate`），刷新页面后技能出现在目录中；也可在对话中直接用 `/plan-gate` 显式调用。

## 安装（本地 link，当前 DSH 版本）

DSH 目前没有发布这些包到 npm，用 profile 的 `link:` 安装：

```bash
# 1) 克隆本仓库
git clone https://github.com/pengxiaozi/dsh-plugins.git

# 2) 在 DSH profile 目录安装（Windows 默认 %DSH_HOME%\profiles\<profile>）
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add "link:<repo>/dsh-mcp-panel"
pnpm add "link:<repo>/dsh-skill-panel"
pnpm add "link:<repo>/dsh-sensitive-mask"
pnpm add "link:<repo>/dsh-sec-checklist"

# 3) 在 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 末尾追加：
#    "dsh-mcp-panel",
#    "dsh-skill-panel",
#    "dsh-sensitive-mask",
#    "dsh-sec-checklist"
#    或在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里用 loader insert 行加载（推荐，宿主回写 bundles 时不会丢）

# 4) 刷新 DSH 页面（Ctrl+F5）；未出现则重启 DSH
```

卸载：从 bundles 移除四个名字，`pnpm remove dsh-mcp-panel dsh-skill-panel dsh-sensitive-mask dsh-sec-checklist`，删除插件目录。

## 兼容性

- 已在 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1**（Windows 桌面版，`desktop` profile / web 面）验证；
- 只使用公开插件面：`webServer`、`loader`、`configEditor`、`tools`、`skills`、`profileContext`；
- 不依赖任何第三方运行时依赖，插件代码只用 Node 内置模块。

## 安全与隐私

- **不收集、不上传任何数据**：无遥测、无外部请求；列表/读写/导出全部在本机完成。
- **MCP 面板**会把服务器配置（含 `headers` 中的 `Authorization` 等令牌）写入 **profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 明文**。请勿把 profile 目录提交到公共仓库；建议优先使用 `127.0.0.1` 本地地址。
- **Skills 面板只读**：不修改、不删除 skill 文件；ZIP 在内存中生成后直接返回浏览器。
- 导出路径与技能名来自 DSH 技能目录（`ctx.skills`），不接受任意文件系统路径。
- **脱敏显示**：规则与命中日志只保存在本机 profile；日志默认只记规则、脱敏结果、长度与 hash，**不记原文**（可在设置里显式打开）；占位符映射只在进程内存中，重启即清空；插件不发起任何外部请求。
- **安全清单**：项目/授权/范围/测试账号只保存在本机 profile（`sec-checklist.json`）；密码为本地明文，默认**不会**写进运行时技能或模型上下文（需在设置里显式打开「把密码写进清单」）；插件不内置任何真实凭据，不发起外部请求。

## 开发与测试

每个插件目录下都有自包含测试：

```bash
node dsh-mcp-panel/test/smoke.mjs
node dsh-skill-panel/test/smoke.mjs
node dsh-skill-panel/test/host-routes.mjs   # 用假 ctx 跑通 state/body/export 路由
node dsh-sensitive-mask/test/smoke.mjs
node dsh-sensitive-mask/test/host-routes.mjs
node dsh-sec-checklist/test/smoke.mjs
node dsh-sec-checklist/test/host-routes.mjs   # 假 ctx：运行时技能注册、state/config/preview/doc/reveal/reset
```

修改 host 代码后，在 profile 里触发一次配置重载（例如改一下 `cordis.patch.yml` 的时间戳内容），或重启 DSH，新代码才会生效。

## English

Four community plugins for DeepSeek Harness: **dsh-mcp-panel** (inspect and edit MCP connections from Settings), **dsh-skill-panel** (browse skills and export them as ZIP), **dsh-sensitive-mask** (mask user input and tool results before they reach the model, with configurable placeholder / partial / fixed styles and local audit logs) and **dsh-sec-checklist** (pentest checklist with project/scope/credentials config, selectable pentest skills and a generated `security-checklist` runtime skill the agent can load). All run fully locally with no telemetry or external requests. Install via `pnpm add link:<path>` in your DSH profile and append the package names to `dsh.profile.bundles`.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 pengxiaozi

plugins.description: SourceDeck · 资料台 for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: background research, screen and compare open-source sources, then reference selections into the chat draft. Maintains DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
plugins.readme_text:
# SourceDeck / 资料台

> 中文（默认） | [English](README.en.md)

[GitHub](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) · [0.3.3 预发行](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.3.3) · [稳定版 0.3.0](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.3.0) · [GitMCP](https://gitmcp.io/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) · [Marketplace PR #7739](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7739)

SourceDeck 是给 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 用的开源资料工作台。它把“先看看别人怎么做的”从十几个浏览器标签页、零散书签和聊天记录里收进一个侧栏：后台研究、卡片筛选、并排对比，再把选中的仓库引用回当前对话。

## 为什么做 SourceDeck

大部分产品设计，其实已经有人做过。与其从零重复造轮子，更常见的做法是先找成熟的开源实现，读它的架构、交互和取舍，再决定直接复用、借鉴，还是绕开。

真正麻烦的往往不是“搜不到”，而是搜到之后：十几个仓库怎么快速比较？哪些看过、为什么排除？选中的怎么带回当前对话，让 Agent 基于真实代码继续？

SourceDeck 就是为这个中间过程做的。它把一次调研变成一条可复查的链路：

> 说清需求 → 后台研究 → 卡片筛选 → 并排对比 → 引用回对话 → 继续开发

适合：技术选型、同类/竞品调研、找可复用实现、给 Agent 补真实背景资料。  
不适合：替代深度代码审计，或替代正式的安全/合规评估。

## 界面预览

真实 Host 截图（浅色 / 深色），以 Hermes Agent、OpenClaw 等主流 Agent 项目为例。截图中的账号信息已脱敏。

| 浅色 | 深色 |
|---|---|
| ![资料台浅色界面](docs/assets/screenshots/source-deck-light.png) | ![资料台深色界面](docs/assets/screenshots/source-deck-dark.png) |

## 对话与资料台联动

资料台不是另一个孤立的搜索页。它和左侧对话共用同一个会话上下文，研究结果、筛选决定和引用都留在同一处。

1. **从对话发起**：输入 `/deck 找几个主流 Agent 框架...`，或直接说“用资料台找…”。主 Agent 通过 `deck_search` 启动官方受管子会话；主对话不阻塞，可以继续干活。
2. **结果回到同一会话**：候选进入右侧资料台；对话里保留一张资料卡片，点“在资料台打开”回到原主题。子会话的搜索提示留在子会话，不会把主对话刷满。
3. **在资料台做决定**：保留 / 排除、写原因、收藏、最多四项对比；这些决定按会话/主题隔离，切到别的会话不会串台。
4. **引用回对话**：点“引用到对话”，保留项作为不可变快照进入输入框；原有正文、附件不丢，也不会自动发送。然后继续写“参考这几个仓库，给我们的设计提改进方案”。
5. **改判不影响已插入引用**：之后改判只影响新引用；已插入的是当时快照，发送前可移除。

左侧继续对话，右侧资料台同步；底部输入框已插入 SourceDeck 引用，并续写开发要求：

| 浅色 | 深色 |
|---|---|
| ![对话与资料台联动浅色](docs/assets/screenshots/source-deck-linkage-light.png) | ![对话与资料台联动深色](docs/assets/screenshots/source-deck-linkage-dark.png) |

## 适配与安装

| 项目 | 精确版本 |
|---|---|
| 本插件 | 0.3.3 |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop | 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| @deepseek-ai/cordis | 4.0.5 |

只使用 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的公共接口。**目前只维护这个 RC 基线；更新迭代快的 alpha 版本暂不提供支持。** 升级到新的 RC 或正式版需要单独评估和验收。

在 Desktop 的插件管理页选择本地安装 `dsh-source-deck-0.3.3.tgz`，按提示重启。安装列表显示自定义资料卡图标及「SourceDeck · 资料台」。重复开发安装应使用新版本或带内容哈希的新 tgz 路径；同路径同版本可能被包管理器缓存。

市场收录 PR [#7739](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7739) 目前仍为 open，等待自动复检与合并，当前不声称已上架。详见 [市场记录](docs/MARKETPLACE.md)。

## 从聊天开始

- 直接说：`用资料台找几个主流 Agent 框架，比较 stars 和维护活跃度`。模型通过 `deck_search` 启动研究；自然语言触发取决于模型是否调用工具。
- 确定性入口：`/deck 找 Markdown 编辑器，优先开源和可扩展`。带参数开始后台研究，单独 `/deck` 只打开面板。
- 也可点输入框「资料台」、右栏 `+ → 资料台` 或对话卡片「在资料台打开」。历史卡片定位原主题。

研究由官方受管子会话执行，默认继承主会话的模型配置与凭据策略，会产生额外并发模型请求。Host 读取最近主对话作为资料理解上下文。搜索和补搜的内部提示留在子会话；主聊天可继续开发，保留简短的命令/工具状态及资料卡片。

研究工具仅允许 `web_search`、`web_fetch`、`deck_submit_sources`。需要官方网页工具和 spawn provider 可用；无法安全启动时显示失败原因，不自动改配置或升级基线。

## 筛选与比较

0.3.3 优先显示已有的「筛选说明」，方便先看资料与本次需求的关系；简介和完整说明都保留在来源详情中。缺少说明时回退到简介或摘录，不生成新的判断。对比按资料台宽度适配：不足 620px 时按维度纵向阅读，每个值带来源名称；宽栏保留表格，最多四项。研究流程和引用行为保持不变。

0.3.2 收拢了结果页：新搜索与补充要求按需展开，候选和收藏各自记住查询，对比从已选项进入并恢复返回焦点。卡片显示保存状态；引用及直接摘要会等待已有筛选写入，失败时保留草稿供重试。详情仍可展开查看完整说明。

完整读取改为串行：研究中约 2 秒一次，静置结果 30 秒一次；收藏页或面板隐藏时暂停定期完整读取，返回时刷新。没有增加后台服务或依赖。0.3.2 按预发行交付：6/24/200 条列表、完整分钟读取和主要任务已实测，原生 Electron 125% 缩放、真实 IME、附件组合及真人观察仍有限制。实测方法和边界见[实施记录](docs/implementation/2026-10-19-experience-optimization.md)，稳定入口保留 0.3.0。

1. 卡片展示仓库图 / Logo，失败时尝试 GitHub owner 头像，再显示字标。GitHub 的 stars、最近代码推送时间、查询时间与来源链接分别显示。未知数据明确显示未知，0 stars 保留为 0。
2. `✓ 保留` / `✕ 排除`，再次点击同一选项恢复待处理；可展开填写原因。收藏、对比与筛选互相独立。
3. 点「加入对比」后打开「对比」，最多四个来源，可比较简介、stars、更新时间、语言、许可证及筛选理由。
4. 默认双列；面板内容宽度小于 620px 自动单列。深浅模式跟随 Host，包括设置下拉选项。需求、补充说明、原因草稿和对比选择按会话 / 主题保留在浏览器 sessionStorage。
5. 底部「补充查找」展开输入后，「继续查找」启动同主题新轮次，携带保留项、排除项与原因；「新搜索」展开新需求，点击开始才创建新集合，收起不会丢草稿。旧结果仍可从对话卡片查看。
6. 运行中可筛选、收藏、对比和引用；「停止研究」只停止该轮子任务。五分钟超时会结束研究并保留已到达候选。Host 重启后未恢复的研究显示中断，可重试。

## 引用后继续开发

选好资料，点 **「引用到对话（N 条）」**。主输入框原有正文、附件和引用保留，不会自动发送。然后续写，例如：

> 参考这几个仓库，学习其中的 UI 设计，结合本仓库现有组件提出优化并实现。

也可在主输入框输入 `@deck`，选择当前保留项或历史快照。引用保存标题、真实 URL、说明、metadata 和筛选原因的不可变快照；之后改判不会悄悄更改已插入的资料。点击引用可回看原主题，发送前可移除。

插入期间若用户继续输入、切会话或当前输入框不可用，会保留原草稿并提示重试；清除数据后的失效引用会阻止发送，需移除后重选。

次要入口「直接发送筛选摘要」立即投递摘要并把集合设为只读，失败可重试且使用同一请求身份。需要续写开发说明时优先使用引用。

## 收藏与高级设置

卡片 ☆ 保存至当前 profile 共用收藏夹，支持搜索、移除、重新加入资料台。收藏会跨会话共享，重启保留。

设置页「资料台」提供可选的 GitHub / Web / LLM 自主来源策略，以及清除插件数据。策略用于提示和标记，不保证模型结果严格合规。卸载不会自动删除已有记录。

## 数据与限制

- 本地 `source_deck` 域保持八表：sets、sources、candidates、selections、scope_policies、session_active、rounds、favorites。旧记录可读取；搜索结果绑定原主题和轮次。
- 插件不读取凭据文件或保存 API Key。搜索提示与网页请求按 Host 的配置发送给提供方；外部内容序列化为资料数据，不能替代用户指令。
- 图片受原站、网络及 Host CSP 影响；失败不影响筛选或链接。模型未查证的 metadata 不应当作真实统计。
- 并发受模型提供方额度及官方子会话设置约束；不提供跨设备同步、导出或版本链 diff。
- 真实 Host 验收范围与未验收项目见 [验收记录](docs/SETUP-VERIFICATION.md)。

## 参与共建

SourceDeck 还在早期，很多取舍可以一起讨论。欢迎 fork、提 issue、提 PR。

- **遇到问题**：开 issue，附上 DSH 版本、插件版本、复现步骤和相关日志；请先脱敏。
- **想改代码**：fork 后从 `main` 开分支，保持精确 peer，跑 `node --test tests/*.test.ts` 和 `npm run build`，在 PR 里说明动机、取舍和验证。
- **想补来源 / 场景**：欢迎补适配和测试；请避免把 alpha 专有 API 带进来。

不要求一次写完整个功能。一个清楚的场景、一条测试、一段文案，都是有价值的贡献。

## 检索与索引

- GitHub 仓库：<https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck>（可搜索 `dsh-plugin`、`source-deck`、`DeepSeek Harness`）
- 最新 Release：<https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.3.0>
- GitMCP 文档索引：<https://gitmcp.io/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck>
- 插件市场：awesome-dsh-plugin [PR #7739](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7739)（审核中，未上架）

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build
node --test tests/*.test.ts
npm pack
```

产物为 Host `lib/index.js`、Client lazy-CJS `lib/client.js`、types、图标及中英 locale。精确 peer 保持不变，无新增依赖。

- [v3 设计](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-sourcedeck-v3-design.md)
- [已批准实施计划](docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-sourcedeck-v3.md)
- [开发工作流调研](docs/research/2026-10-18-developer-workflow-review.md)
- [同类工具体验与性能调研](docs/research/2026-10-19-comparable-tools-experience-review.md) · [优化迭代提案（待评审）](docs/design/2026-10-19-experience-iteration-proposal.md)
- [交接](docs/HANDOFF.md) · [版本策略](docs/VERSION-POLICY.md)

plugins.description: DSH Dot: a persistent read-only-first proactive agent for DeepSeek Harness, with user-approved execution.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Dot

[![CI](https://github.com/1315577677/dsh-dot-plugin/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/1315577677/dsh-dot-plugin/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

![DSH Dot](icon.svg)

**A persistent, read-only-first proactive agent for DeepSeek Harness, with user-approved execution.**

`dsh-dot-plugin` is a DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness a real Dot: its own durable Agent Session, a read-only research phase, independent risk review, user-only approvals, and a tightly-scoped execution phase.

It is inspired by the capability model of OpenAI's Dots, but it is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to OpenAI, and it does not attempt to reproduce OpenAI's hosted cloud computer or 4,000+ app marketplace.

---

## Why

Most agent plugins are reactive: they answer, then stop. Dot is designed to keep a thread of work alive:

1. inspect real, configured sources without modifying anything;
2. decide whether something is worth doing;
3. prepare a concrete proposal;
4. ask the user when the action has real-world consequences;
5. execute only the approved action, with only the approved tools;
6. record the real result and keep long-running work moving.

The ordinary conversation you use to code is **not** intercepted. Dot has its own Session and its own tool policy.

---

## Features

| Capability | How it works |
| --- | --- |
| Persistent Dot Agent | A top-level Agent/Session resumed from durable state; title `Dot` |
| Task orchestrator | Dot creates tasks, assigns real worker Agents, tracks status, handles approvals, and lets the user switch focus |
| Native Dot workspace | The Dot Session plus a right rail for status, approvals, tasks, schedules, triggers, recent outputs, and sources |
| Read-only research | Global tool allowlist + a scoped, monotonic `tools.guard()` |
| Real sources | Local directories, public/API URLs, and read-only MCP tools |
| Proposals | `dot_propose_action` writes a durable proposal; it never executes |
| Independent risk review | A separate small model classifies every proposal; the proposing model does not grade itself |
| User-only approval | DSH panel and `/dot` slash command; no Agent Tool can approve a proposal |
| Scoped execution | An approved execution turn receives only that proposal's tools |
| Task tracking | `dot_add_task` / `dot_update_task`; progress comes from real evidence |
| DSH schedules | `dot_schedule_task` uses the Host `schedule` service, not a private cron loop |
| Event triggers | `dot_register_trigger` + local webhook/service entry point |
| No global rule hijack | Rules apply to Dot only, not to the user's other Sessions |
| Result attribution | Execution results are read only from the execution turn, and interrupted turns are marked failed |

---

## Architecture

```text
                       ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                       │        DSH Host             │
                       │                             │
  user approval ──────▶│  DotRuntime                 │
  (panel or /dot)      │   ├─ Dot Agent/Session      │
                       │   ├─ read-only research     │
                       │   ├─ proposal store         │
                       │   └─ execution allowlist    │
                       │                             │
  sources ────────────▶│  read / glob / grep         │
  (directory/URL/MCP)  │  web_search / web_fetch     │
                       └──────────────┬──────────────┘
                                      │ DSH slots
                       ┌──────────────▼──────────────┐
                       │      Client panel           │
                       │  sidebar icon + main panel  │
                       │  proposals / tasks / status │
                       └─────────────────────────────┘
```

The Dot Agent is created with the `standard` DSH preset, then a Dot-scoped prompt section and scoped tools are added.

### Research phase

- Allowed global tools default to `read`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, `web_fetch`.
- Everything else is removed with `tools.restrict()` when possible.
- A scoped `tools.guard()` denies any other call even if a preset-scoped tool is not filtered by the global restriction.
- The research prompt tells Dot to inspect only the configured sources and to propose — not execute — work.
- `dot_schedule_task`, `dot_add_task`, and `dot_register_trigger` are internal bookkeeping tools and remain available during research.

### Proposal phase

`dot_propose_action` records:

- title, description, proposed outcome;
- source and evidence;
- `execution_tools` (for example `["write"]`);
- an exact `execution_instruction`.

A separate `Reviewer` asks a small model for a risk verdict (`low` / `medium` / `high`) with a reason. User rules are applied after that. The default configuration does **not** auto-approve even low-risk proposals; opt in with `autoApproveLowRisk: true`.

### Execution phase

Approval is user-only. On approval:

1. the research restriction is lifted;
2. an execution allowlist is built from the proposal's `executionTools` plus `read` / `glob` / `grep`;
3. the Dot Agent receives an execution prompt in the same Session;
4. the scoped guard denies every tool outside that allowlist;
5. when the turn ends, the result is read from that turn only and written back to the proposal.

High-risk actions such as send, publish, pay, delete, invite, or credential access are expected to be proposed as drafts or preparatory steps. The user can reject them, or configure stricter rules.

---

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **Desktop** or `dsh web` profile
- Node.js >= 22
- pnpm
- A working default model route in DSH
- For real app connectors: the corresponding read-only MCP tools in DSH

The plugin was tested against the DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` family.

---

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/1315577677/dsh-dot-plugin.git
cd dsh-dot-plugin
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm test
```

Then install the local bundle with DSH's Plugin Manager:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/dsh-dot-plugin
```

Or install it from the DSH Plugin Manager UI by choosing the local bundle directory.

### Desktop note

The Host half activates immediately. The Client half (sidebar icon + panel) is part of the web boot graph, so **fully quit and reopen DSH Desktop** after installing or replacing the Client bundle. A browser-style page refresh is not available in the Desktop shell.

After reopening, the sidebar shows **DSH Dot** and the Dot Session appears in the Session list.

---

## Configure sources

The default `cordis.patch.yml` intentionally contains no machine-specific sources. Add real read-only sources under the `config.sources` list and reinstall the bundle (or override the row in your profile patch).

### Local directory

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-dot-plugin
      name: 'dsh-dot-plugin'
      config:
        enabled: true
        agentPreset: standard
        dotWorkspace: '/absolute/path/to/workspace'
        sources:
          - id: inbox
            kind: directory
            label: Local inbox
            path: '/absolute/path/to/inbox'
        readOnlyTools: [read, glob, grep, web_search, web_fetch]
        executionTools: [write, edit]
```

`dotWorkspace` is the Dot Session's cwd and the workspace used by the file sandbox. It should contain the files you want Dot to be able to write after approval.

### Public URL / API

```yaml
sources:
  - id: github
    kind: url
    label: GitHub issues
    url: 'https://api.github.com/repos/owner/repo/issues?state=open&per_page=10'
```

Dot uses `web_fetch` for URL sources.

### Real apps via MCP

Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, GitHub, or another app through DSH's MCP support, then expose only read tools to Dot:

```yaml
sources:
  - id: mail
    kind: mcp
    label: Gmail read-only
    tools: [gmail_search, gmail_read]

readOnlyTools:
  - read
  - glob
  - grep
  - web_search
  - web_fetch
  - gmail_search
  - gmail_read
```

This plugin does not embed OAuth credentials, app passwords, or a vendor connector. The MCP server owns authentication and the tool surface; DSH owns the tool registry.

plugins.description: BOSSmode — Your turn to be the boss. Open-source product collaboration for Codex and DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# BOSSmode — 这次，轮到你当老板

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

BOSSmode（原名 Builder Mode）是用于 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的本地产品协作插件。你用自然语言表达目标、体验成果、提出判断；一个持续负责的 AI 伙伴承担研究、实施、协调、检查和解释，不要求你选择技术框架或搬运子任务结果。

你负责说“我有个想法”、看进度、试成果、提意见；AI 负责把方案讲清楚，并推进日常工作。“老板许愿”是个玩笑，能被检查、能继续改进的交付才是正事。

“老板体验”不是躺着等奇迹：你仍决定方向、范围、预算和重要取舍；系统应让你看懂进度、结果和影响，不把工程管理交回给你。长期愿景是让普通人也能围绕自己的目标组织专业 AI 协作，不预设行业或固定角色；当前能力以实际验证范围为准。本项目为社区插件，不是 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 官方产品。

采用 Apache License 2.0，见 LICENSE。当前为预览版；内部技术验收不等于所有用户都能顺利完成任意项目，也不是成熟通用专业团队的保证。

## 用户从这里开始

插件启用后，在独立产品文件夹中新建任务，直接说：“我想完成……，先帮我理解目标与最小方案。”不需要学习内部命令或预先配置团队角色。

新项目会先说明第一版能帮你做什么、在哪里使用、先做什么与暂不做什么，再听你的判断。单独选择 AI 服务不代表认可整套方案。对齐后普通工作由负责人自主推进，不反复问“继续吗”；每次解释先说对你的使用和判断意味着什么。旧项目保留已有成果，只补齐接下来这一版的方案理解，不从头重做。

你可以问：“现在能体验什么？”“这会带来什么效果？”“这个地方太复杂，帮我简化。”需要你判断时，负责人应解释选项、影响和推荐理由。预期不是保证；指出困惑本身就是有效反馈。

`0.2.0-preview.3` 新增回复表达检查：进展、提问和最终说明须先检查实际草稿，再发送通过的原文；默认少技术，检查已识别的黑话和未解释术语。只有你明确说自己有相关基础时，才有限增加该领域的细节；随时说“简单一点”即可恢复。检查器不额外调用模型、不保存整份草稿，也不改变你的操作授权。它不是独立事实认证或宿主所有输出的强制拦截；已知规则可能漏检，负责人仍须自查意思和风险。保存表达偏好仍遵守宿主权限；被拒绝时会说明未保存，不绕过限制，也不假装跨对话已记住。详见[本次验证范围](release/reply-review-validation.json)。

首次安装可把本源码文件夹交给当前助手，要求它按下面说明检查环境并完成本地安装；不要把源码文件夹当作你要制作的产品目录。

## 安装者和维护者说明

本版实际验证范围：macOS 15.5 / Apple Silicon、Node.js 24、Codex CLI 0.154.0、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。DSH 使用官方 Web 界面和原生 Session；不声称已测试独立桌面打包应用、Intel Mac、Windows、Linux或所有未来版本。需使用者自己的宿主和模型访问权限；不承诺调用免费或无限。BOSSmode 本身不打包第三方运行依赖。实际流程与保留的失败见 [验证范围](release/validation.json)。

### DSH 用户

已有 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、Node 24 和 pnpm 时，从下载/克隆的源码根目录安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:$PWD"
dsh web
```

从本仓库固定版本直接安装（需要 Git 与 pnpm）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cedricxie366-stack/BOSSmode#v0.2.0-preview.3
```

也可在 DSH 官方界面的“插件 → 添加插件”中选择这个源码目录。为兼容已有安装，DSH 管理页的包标识仍是 `builder-mode`，说明为 BOSSmode，且它的 3 个组件应均在运行。插件不选择或更换你的模型、不收集密钥、不放宽权限；先在 DSH 中完成自己的模型配置。项目工作文件夹另选，不要使用源码目录。

SDK 自动化用户可安装到 `sdk` profile；`headless` 用户安装到 `headless` profile。各 profile 分开安装。SDK 的权限问答能力不等同于 Web 界面；不要为了通过测试关闭权限保护，也不要同时从两个 DSH 进程控制同一个 Session。

停用使用插件页面开关；卸载可用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove builder-mode`。这些操作不删除你的产品文件和 `.builder-mode` 项目记录。换聊天或重新启用后，要求负责人读取原项目继续，不要清空状态。

### Codex 用户

从本源码根目录运行：

```sh
npm --prefix plugins/builder-mode test
codex plugin marketplace add .
codex plugin add builder-mode@builder-mode-local
```

命令对应已测 CLI；其他客户端先核对支持。注册/安装须经使用者授权，不修改认证。更新后建议新建任务确保加载完整规则，不要让旧版任务和新版任务同时写同一产品目录；两个宿主也不要同时修改同一个产品。

源码 test 包含插件功能、负责人简报、业务决策、安全与恢复回归；不代表真实用户成功率。合成行为场景见 evals/owner-experience/scenarios.json。运行包不含开发脚本，修改与测试请使用源码包。

## 当前限制

`0.2.0-preview.2` 是此前的品牌与双语文档更新；`0.2.0-preview.3` 增加回复审查和沟通偏好。完整真实模型构建流程的历史证据基线仍为 `0.2.0-preview.1`，见 [历史验证范围](release/validation.json)。本轮表达检查与合成场景不代替真实用户理解或满意度验证，也不代表重新完成了所有宿主界面的完整流程。

小型报名样例有行为检查，其他文件成果有数据检查和版本绑定评审；结构通过不等于事实/创作品质认证。备份主状态、日志、冻结成果，不自动备份实时业务数据。旧执行者状态不明时阻断重派。暂不支持无人值守生产发布、支付或真实客户资料流程。Codex 与 DSH 二选一即可，不需要自建 Builder Web。

你可停用插件而保留产品目录及 .builder-mode；不要为排错删除状态。更多使用与恢复边界见插件 README。

## 更名与旧项目

品牌与 GitHub 仓库名称已改为 BOSSmode；`builder-mode` 安装包/技能标识、`builder_*` 工具、`.builder-mode` 数据目录和旧版本标签保留。不要手工改这些名字，不需要迁移或重做产品。旧 GitHub 地址会重定向至新地址。该更名不表示完成商标或同名权利检索。

BOSSmode 是本仓库独立维护的社区项目，与其他同名 AI 产品无关联；请以本仓库地址和安装说明识别。名称存在其他使用者，不宣称独占或已获得商标保护。

## 反馈

告诉维护者：想完成什么、看到什么、哪一步让你承担了不懂的技术工作、期望怎样。先删去个人资料与凭据，不要上传整个项目状态目录。反馈入口为本仓库 Issues；秘密与安全问题见 SECURITY.md。插件不会自动提交或公开项目内容。

# dsh-accountdisplayname-edit Replaces the sidebar account label — the phone number, email, or account name DeepSeek Harness shows at the bottom-left — and the avatar above it, with a name and image you choose, so screenshots do not expose the original. The edit entry is a new **Edit display name** row in the account menu, the one you open by clicking that label. The dialog it opens holds both the avatar and the name. ## What it does - Replaces the account label text in the sidebar footer with a display name you set. - Replaces the launcher avatar with an image you pick from a local file. - Adds an **Edit display name** / **编辑显示名称** row to the account menu, directly under Settings. - Opens one editor dialog for both: pick or clear an avatar, type a name, then Save, Cancel, or Use default. `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels. - Both edits are drafts until Save — Cancel leaves the sidebar untouched. - Saving an empty value restores the account's own text; clearing the avatar restores the account's own avatar. - A picked image is centre-cropped square, downscaled to 128×128 and re-encoded, so the stored copy stays in the low tens of KB. - Stores both per browser in `localStorage`, under `dsh.account-display-name-edit.alias` and `dsh.account-display-name-edit.avatar`. - Display only. The account, the credentials and the profile are never read or changed, and the plugin makes no network requests of its own. ## Requirements Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The account launcher and `Menu` DOM it targets — `data-signed-out`, the `_avatar` / `_label` spans, the portaled `div[role="menu"]` with its `role="presentation"` viewport and `itemIcon` / `itemLabel` rows — is unchanged in `0.2.1-rc.2`, which this package was checked against. The host half imports nothing and the browser half fails soft, so a build whose DOM has moved on degrades to "no override, no extra row" rather than an error — see [Compatibility](#compatibility). ## Install ### From the desktop app The `desktop` profile is managed exclusively by the Electron application, so install it there through the app's own plugin surface (Settings → Plugins, or `dshmarket`); the CLI refuses that profile by design. ### From the CLI, for any profile the app does not own ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit ``` There is **no build step and no `prepare` script**: the browser half is committed as `lib/client.js`, so pnpm never asks for build approval and the install is a plain file copy. ### Manually, which is exactly what the commands above do 1. Put the package where the profile resolves its bundles — `/profiles//node_modules/dsh-accountdisplayname-edit`. A directory junction/symlink to a checkout works. 2. Add this to `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: account-display-name-edit name: dsh-accountdisplayname-edit ``` That patch layer is watched, so it applies live — no restart needed. ## Use 1. Click the account row at the bottom of the sidebar. 2. Choose **Edit display name**. 3. Optionally click **Choose image…** and pick a PNG / JPG / WebP; the round preview shows the cropped result. **Clear avatar** goes back to the account's own avatar. 4. Type the name you want. Save an empty value to go back to the account's own text. 5. Click **Save**. Nothing changes until you do. ## Screenshots The account menu, with the **Edit display name** row added under Settings, and the chosen name and avatar on the launcher below it: ![The account menu with the Edit display name row](assets/screenshot-1.png) The editor dialog: avatar preview, name field, and Save / Cancel / Use default: ![The editor dialog](assets/screenshot-2.png) ## Uninstall Remove the insert from `cordis.patch.yml` and delete the package directory. The stored name and avatar stay in the browser's `localStorage` until you clear them; the plugin writes nothing else. ## How it works A dual-face plugin whose host half does almost nothing. - **Host half — `lib/index.js`.** Deliberately import-free. Its only job is to be a Loader entry, so the host's client-module scanner reads `dsh.client` from `package.json` and serves `./client` to the browser. With no dependencies and no `peerDependencies`, it cannot fail to load because of a missing, renamed or version-mismatched peer package. - **Browser half — `lib/client.js`.** A hand-written single-file bundle, already in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` form the module system serves verbatim, so the package needs no build. It requires only `react`, which the shell seeds as a platform module — which is why `react` is not a dependency either. ### Why the menu row is done in the DOM `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` renders that menu from a hard-coded `items` array, and its only slot (`settings.launcher`, a `single` slot) is the launcher row itself. Occupying that slot would delete 设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录, which this plugin must not do. There is no menu-item slot to add to. So the row is appended to the **open** menu's list, cloned from a shipped row — it therefore inherits that build's exact markup, classes and styling. Appending one node leaves React's own children untouched, and the row is removed with the menu because React never tracked it. Selectors use only stable identifiers, never a hashed CSS-module prefix: - the launcher is `button[aria-haspopup="menu"][data-signed-out]`, an attribute the account component always writes; the text node is found by the `_label` suffix and the avatar by the `_avatar` suffix, with positional fallbacks; - the menu is a `div[role="menu"]` the `Menu` primitive portals to ``, identified as the one that appeared after the launcher was activated. ### How the avatar is replaced The avatar span's real contents are React's — an `` or an initial. Rather than remove them, the plugin paints the picked image as the span's **background** and hides the span's children with one scoped rule: ```css [data-dsh-accountdisplayname-edit-avatar="1"] > * { display: none !important } ``` That is two attribute writes and a background image; no React-owned node is detached, re-parented or replaced, so a later account refresh cannot collide with it. Clearing the avatar removes the attribute and the background, and the real avatar reappears. ### Failing soft Every DOM probe runs inside `try`/`catch`; when a probe misses, the plugin does nothing — it never edits another node and never throws into the shell's plugin loader. Clearing the name hands the account plugin's own text back. The label is written through React's own text node (`nodeValue`, not `textContent`), so later account refreshes stay observable instead of updating a node React no longer owns. ## Compatibility - `dsh.client.immediately: true` is required: the plugin works through side effects registered when its bundle materializes, so it belongs in the boot graph's immediate tier. - No `engines.dsh` range is declared, on purpose. node-semver only admits a prerelease version when some comparator in the range shares its exact `major.minor.patch` tuple and itself carries a prerelease tag, so any range would silently exclude a later prerelease of the harness — the failure mode the awesome-dsh-plugin contributing guide warns about. Failing soft is the safer contract here. ## Verification ```sh npm install npm test ``` 116 checks against a real DOM (jsdom + React 18.3.1): - `test/dom.test.mjs` — 40 checks: the bundle wrapper contract, `apply()` registration, label replacement, re-application after the account half re-renders, menu-row injection (label, icon, dropped shortcut, insertion position, shipped rows untouched), row activation closing the menu and opening the dialog, save and reset, and disposal. - `test/robustness.test.mjs` — 16 checks over the fail-soft paths: the account row gone entirely, the `_label` class renamed, the collapsed rail where the avatar is the only span, an English locale, a menu rendered before its rows exist, no `document.body`, t

# dsh-approval-reminder

命令在 DeepSeek Harness 里等待审批时，用 **Edge / Windows 桌面通知**提醒你。

> 适用对象：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面 + Windows 上的 Microsoft Edge。
> 插件本身是纯 JavaScript、无依赖、无构建步骤。

---

## 它做什么

DSH 在命令需要更高权限（例如沙箱拒绝后升级）时会发起一次审批请求，宿主会在会话输入框上方显示审批面板。如果当时你没盯在那一屏——切到别的会话、Edge 被最小化、正在做别的事——很容易漏掉。

这个插件在**每个待审批请求**出现时发一条系统通知：

**只在你不看这个页面时提醒。** 页面可见且处于前台（你正看着对话）时不发通知——审批面板本来就在屏上；页面切到后台、最小化或失去焦点时才提醒。回到页面后，已经弹出的通知会自动关闭。

- 标题：`需要审批`
- 正文：请求方给出的原因（或“工具 `pwsh` 请求以更高权限执行”）+ 所属会话名
- 点击通知：切回对应的会话，并把 Edge 窗口带到前台
- 审批被回答、取消或撤回后：通知自动关闭
- 同一会话的连续请求会替换旧通知，不会堆一屏

它**不参与**审批决策：只读取浏览器端的“会话待审批状态”快照，从不拦截 `approval/request`，因此不会改变任何审批结果。

## 前提条件

1. Windows 的 **设置 → 系统 → 通知** 里允许 **Microsoft Edge**（关闭时系统会丢弃网页通知）。
2. 不要处于专注助手/勿扰模式。
3. DSH Web 页面保持打开（可以最小化；关掉标签页就不会再有通知）。
4. 首次使用需要在 Edge 里允许本站点显示通知（见下一节）。

## 安装

在装好 DSH 的机器上，任选一种：

```powershell
# 从 GitHub 安装（pnpm 的 GitHub 简写）
dsh plugin --profile web add In-clude/dsh-approval-reminder

# 或从本地目录安装（开发时）
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\path\to\dsh-approval-reminder"
```

也可以在 DSH Web 的 **设置 → 插件** 页里安装/启用/禁用/卸载。

安装后无需重启 DSH：bundle 会作为当前 profile 的一个插件条目激活；浏览器端刷新页面即可看到效果。

## 首次授权

浏览器只允许**用户手势**触发通知授权，所以插件有两条路，任选其一：

- 页面加载后**第一次点击/按键**时，插件会请求一次通知权限（每次页面加载最多一次）；
- 或者打开 **设置 → 通用 → 审批桌面通知**，点「开启」。

授权后，那一行的状态变成「已开启」，并出现 **发送测试通知** 按钮——用它可以在不触发真实审批的情况下确认通道可用。

如果之前点过“阻止”，请在 Edge 地址栏左侧的站点图标里把通知改回允许，然后刷新页面。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-approval-reminder
```

或在 **设置 → 插件** 页里停用/卸载。卸载后通知与设置行一并消失，不留下会话数据。

## 实现要点

| 关注点 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 待审批状态来源 | 订阅 `uiSession.sessionStatus`（`getSnapshot` / `subscribe` 的纯 observable），筛出 `pendingInteraction.kind === 'approval'` 的会话 |
| 提醒时机 | `document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hasFocus()` 视为“正在看页面”→ 静默；在 `visibilitychange` / `focus` / `blur` 时重新判断，所以离开页面后才懒提醒；同一请求只提醒一次，回到页面即关闭已弹出的通知 |
| 通知 | `new Notification(title, { body, tag, requireInteraction: true })`，`tag` 按会话去重 |
| 点击行为 | `uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)` + `window.focus()` |
| 去重 | 每个 `sessionId + request key` 只通知一次；构造失败也记录，避免每次快照变化都重试 |
| 清理 | 订阅、手势监听、设置行、已发通知全部随插件卸载回收 |
| 宿主侧 | 空壳（`index.js` 只有 `apply() {}`）：不注册 Service / Tool / Config / 会话事件 |

生命周期：通知由**页面**发起，因此标签页关闭即停止；DSH 换端口后通知权限按源重新授权。

## 项目结构

```
client.js              # 浏览器 bundle：通知通道 + 设置行（核心逻辑）
index.js               # 宿主半侧空壳
cordis.patch.yml       # bundle 的 Loader patch：插入 approval-reminder 条目
locale/en.json|zh.json # 插件页显示名与描述
icon.svg               # 插件卡片图标
scripts/check.mjs      # 无依赖静态检查（npm test）
.github/workflows/     # CI：push/PR 跑 check
```

## 开发

无依赖、无构建：`client.js` 就是浏览器加载的 bundle，`index.js` 就是宿主加载的 ES 模块。

```powershell
node scripts/check.mjs   # 或 npm test
```

检查内容：manifest 字段、`exports` 指向的文件、locale 元数据、patch 行、两个 JS 文件的语法（`node:vm` 编译检查，不执行代码）。

## 验证状态

在 Windows + Edge（DSH Web `127.0.0.1`）上实测通过：

- 命令等待审批时**弹出** Edge/Windows 桌面通知；
- **点击**通知后该通知消失（同时切回对应会话、聚焦窗口）；
- 审批作出决定（允许或拒绝）后，插件会关闭该请求对应的通知；
- 设置 → 通用 的「发送测试通知」可独立验证通道；
- **0.2.0 提醒时机**：请求挂起时你正看着对话页 → **不弹**；切到别的窗口/最小化后 → **弹出**；回到页面 → 通知自动关闭。

未覆盖：headless / API 会话、页面关闭后的提醒、macOS / Linux 桌面通知、多标签页同时打开时的表现。

## 已知限制

- 仅对**浏览器会话**生效；headless / API 会话没有通知。
- Chromium（Edge）在 Windows 上不支持通知上的“允许/拒绝”按钮，所以通知只做提醒；点通知回到会话里作答。
- 通知是否真能弹出取决于 Windows 通知设置与专注助手，插件无法覆盖。
- 打开多个标签页时，每个页面各自通知自己收到的请求。
- 页面关闭后不再提醒（未使用 Service Worker / Push）。

## English

A DSH Web plugin that raises an Edge/Windows desktop notification whenever a
command is waiting for approval, and closes it once the request is answered.
It only observes the client Session status snapshot (`uiSession.sessionStatus`)
and never joins the `approval/request` waterfall, so approval outcomes are
unaffected. Notifications need a one-time permission grant (first click or the
General-settings row). No dependencies, no build step.

MIT © 2026 In-clude

plugins.description: DSH plugin orchestration and workspace-isolation manager: plugin scanning, per-workspace isolated instances, and a standalone rescue entry.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-orchestrator

**按工作区隔离插件、诊断冲突、并在 DSH 崩溃时自救。**

DSH 插件编排与工作区隔离管理器：插件清单、冲突扫描、按工作区禁用插件（黑名单）、
独立的多开隔离实例，以及一个完全不依赖 DSH 进程的急救工具。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-orchestrator
```

装完**托盘彻底退出 DSH 再启动**（不是关窗口）。

## 三个核心能力

### 1. 工作区插件黑名单（设置 → 工作区编排）

插件默认全开——原生面板怎么开就怎么来。这个面板只负责**局部禁用**：

- 顶部下拉框自动读取 DSH 左侧栏的工作区列表
- 下方列出所有第三方插件，**默认全部打勾**
- **取消勾选 = 在这个工作区禁用该插件**
- 切换工作区，勾选状态随之切换

写入 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-orchestrator/single-mode.json`：

```json
{ "version": 2, "workspaces": { "D:/my-project": { "disabledPlugins": ["dsh-novel-writer"] } } }
```

真正生效在**新建会话**时：进入某工作区，黑名单里的插件被卸载，其余恢复。
离开该工作区会自动还原。

> 带界面的双端插件（如 `dsh-webds-bridge`）后端被卸载后，**页面上的入口要刷新
> （`Ctrl+Shift+R`）才消失**——client 代码已经加载进浏览器了，后端管不到。

### 2. 隔离实例（多开）

面板里的「在此工作区开启隔离实例」，或对 Agent 说「在 `D:\code` 开一个隔离实例」。
独立 profile、独立会话与存储、OS 分配的端口。同样遵守该工作区的黑名单。

### 3. 急救工具

DSH 起不来时**不依赖 DSH**：

```bat
bin\rescue.bat --web        :: 打开独立急救网页面板（127.0.0.1:8765）
bin\rescue.bat desktop --disable <插件id>   :: 命令行禁用坏插件
```

急救面板可以列出插件、把插件**可逆地**移出 `node_modules` 并写入 `disabled: true`，
也支持 bundle 插件（无文件夹可移时改为改配置）。所有改动先备份，可一键恢复。

## Agent 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `scan_plugins` | 列出当前 profile 的第三方插件 |
| `scan_conflicts` | 静态冲突扫描（重复 id / 重复包 / 重复 service / 循环依赖 / 缺依赖） |
| `manage_workspace_scope` | 读写工作区黑名单 |
| `launch/list/stop_workspace_instance` | 隔离实例的生死管理 |
| `debug_single_mode` | 诊断黑名单：报告每行的 `fiber` 是 ACTIVE 还是已卸载 |

直接说「调用 debug_single_mode」即可，它会给出结论，例如
「dsh-webds-bridge：已禁用，fiber 已卸载 —— 单开模式工作正常」。

## 排障

**插件禁用了还在跑？** 调用 `debug_single_mode` 看 `fiber` 列：

- `NONE` = 后端已卸载，你看到的是前端残留 → 刷新页面
- `ACTIVE` = 没禁用成功 → 看下面的调试日志

**开调试日志**（默认关闭）：

```powershell
# 方式一：环境变量后重启
setx DSH_ORCH_DEBUG 1

# 方式二：运行时开启（立即生效）
curl.exe -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{\"enabled\":true}" `
  "http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/workspace-orchestrator/api/scope/debug"
```

日志写入 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-orchestrator/debug.log`，含实际 cwd、`pathKey`、
匹配到的黑名单、每行的 `fiber` 前后状态。

## 离线自测

```powershell
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-context-access.mjs
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-rescue-web.mjs  --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-scope-rpc.mjs   --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-blacklist.mjs   --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
```

共 158 项检查，**拒绝在真实 `~/.dsh` 上运行**。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH 运行时 | `0.2.1-rc.2`（本版本实测） |
| Node | `>= 22.19.0` |
| 前端 | DSH Web / 桌面端共用同一套设置面板 |
| 平台 | Windows 优先（路径规范化、急救 `.bat`）；其余平台未实测 |

## 设计约束

- **零第三方依赖，零 `@deepseek-ai/*` import**——框架能力只通过 `ctx` 获取
- **`apply()` 永不抛错**：任何失败都记录并降级，插件不会是 profile 启动失败的原因
- **绝不写回 profile patch**（除急救工具的显式动作）：黑名单只改内存与自己的映射文件

## What exists today

| Piece | State |
|---|---|
| Bundle patch `cordis.patch.yml` inserting loader row `dsh-workspace-orchestrator` | done |
| `apply(ctx)` — registers seven tools, zero throwing IO, never fails a boot | done |
| `scan_plugins` — third-party plugin inventory **+ live isolated-instance summary** | done |
| `launch_workspace_instance` — one-shot profile, isolated sessions/storages, OS-assigned port | done |
| `list_workspace_instances` — registry + process/port liveness | done |
| `stop_workspace_instance` — by pid / profile name / workspace path | done |
| `lib/orchestrator-core/` — profile & patch orchestration, instance registry, rescue mode | done |
| `bin/rescue.mjs` + `bin/rescue.bat` — standalone rescue (no DSH process needed) | done |
| `bin/rescue.mjs --web` — standalone rescue **web panel** with reversible disable/restore | done |
| Bundle-level rescue (`dsh.profile.bundles`): 仅禁用 / 彻底移除 / 恢复 | done |
| Workspace blacklist (settings panel + `manage_workspace_scope`) | done |
| Conflict scan (`lib/conflict-scan.mjs`, `scan_conflicts` tool + settings panel) | done |
| `debug_single_mode` — live fiber state diagnosis | done |
| Version rollback | **not yet** |

Everything instance-related lives in `lib/orchestrator-core/`; the tools are thin bridges that
translate arguments and render results, so there is exactly one implementation of the behaviour.

## Compatibility

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH runtime verified against | `0.2.0-rc.2` (desktop app build `04f392c9ddd144fa426da2045178797da6db6c11`) |
| Electron / Node host | Electron `44.0.0`, Node `24.18.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `4.0.4` |
| Declared in `package.json` | `dsh.compatibleRuntime: "0.2.0-rc.2"` |

## Engineering contract

- **No `@deepseek-ai/*` import.** Framework capabilities are reached through `ctx`
  (`ctx.tools`, `ctx.logger`). The tool is registered as a plain definition object, so
  `defineTool` is not needed; `lib/patch-yaml.js` and `lib/profile.js` are dependency-free
  and import only `node:` builtins.
- **`apply(ctx)` never throws and performs no IO.** It registers one tool and returns. Every
  failure path logs and degrades. Scanning happens inside `execute`.
- **No HTTP routes.** When one is added it will use the `/plugin-orchestrator/` prefix and
  degrade on conflict.
- **Unique entry id.** `dsh-workspace-orchestrator`; the tool name `scan_plugins` is
  likewise unique (the registry rejects duplicates, which is verified).
- **Read-only.** Stage 1 writes nothing anywhere.

## `scan_plugins`

Reads, in order:

1. `<profile>/package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` (the ordered bundle selection) and
   `dependencies` (what is actually installed).
2. `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` → the user's patch layer: `insert` rows add loader entries,
   id-targeted rows override or disable them.
3. `ctx.get('pluginManager')` → optional. When the official manager service is mounted it
   supplies the runtime version and per-bundle load state. Its absence degrades fields to
   `null`; it never errors.

Returns, per third-party plugin: loader-entry `id`, package `name`, `version`, effective
`enabled`, and the `source` row that produced it (`bundle` / `patch-insert` / `dependency` /
`patch-override`). Bundles under `@deepseek-ai/*` are filtered out and only counted.

### The profile directory

Finding the *active* profile from inside the host process is the subtle part. `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`
and `DSH_PROFILE` are injected into **tool subprocess** environments and may be absent in the
host, so they are only the first guess. Candidates are tried in order
(`env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR` → the launcher's own `--profile` / positional argv → `hmr.baseDir` →`env:DSH_PROFILE` → walk-up from this module) and each is **validated structurally**: a real
profile directory has a `package.json` with a `dsh.profile` field. An unresolved profile is
reported as such rather than guessed.

## Installing

The Desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so the CLI refuses to boot or
`--dump-config` it; plugin installation, however, is supported:

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-workspace-orchestrator
```

For any other profile, list the package in `dsh.profile.bundles` (or load
`cordis.patch.yml` as a `--patch` overlay):

```
dsh --profile <name> --patch <this-dir>/cordis.patch.yml
```

## Layout

```
index.js              apply(ctx), the scan_plugins definition, and its renderer
lib/profile.js        profile-directory discovery and structural validation
lib/patch-yaml.js     dependency-free reader for cordis.patch.yml
lib/scan.js           the inventory: sources, resolution, merge, report
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch inserting the loader row
```

## Known limitation

`lib/patch-yaml.js` is not a general YAML parser. It reads exactly the patch layer's shape and
skips `config:` blocks wholesale (a row's config is arbitrary deployment data — the desktop
profile's `llm-pi-ai` row holds a ~230-line nested provider map). Flow collections, block
scalars, anchors/aliases and multi-document files are reported as diagnostics rather than
silently misread.

## 六个工具与极简用法

| Tool | 一句话 | 自然语言示例 |
|---|---|---|
| `scan_plugins` | 列出当前 profile 的第三方插件 + 已开实例 | 「看看我现在装了哪些第三方插件？」 |
| `scan_conflicts` | 静态冲突扫描（重复 id / 重复包 / 重复 service / 环 / 缺依赖） | 「扫一下当前 profile 有没有插件冲突。」 |
| `manage_workspace_scope` | 读写「工作区 → 禁用黑名单」 | 「在 `D:\novels` 禁用 `dsh-novel-writer`。」 |
| `launch_workspace_instance` | 为工作区拉起隔离实例，返回 URL | 「在 `D:\code` 开一个隔离实例。」 |
| `list_workspace_instances` | 列出本管理器拉起的实例并探活 | 「现在开着几个隔

plugins.description: Aggregate DSH plugin catalogs into a plugin-market index format 1 document for the DeepSeek Harness Discover tab
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-discover-index

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Aggregates the live [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/) catalog into
**plugin market index format 1** — the JSON document the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Discover tab reads.

Published index: <https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json>

> [!NOTE]
> **Requires a recent DSH, and it is used as a custom market.**
> This index is consumed by the experimental **Custom plugin markets** feature, not by
> DSH core. That feature first shipped in **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4** (2026-10-15) and is
> carried by every 0.2.1 build since; an older DSH has no Discover tab and no way to add
> an index source. It is still marked experimental upstream, so it is off by default and
> you switch it on yourself — see [Using it in DSH Discover](#using-it-in-dsh-discover).
>
> Nothing here patches or extends DSH: this repository only publishes a JSON file, and
> DSH reads it once you point the feature at that URL.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project is a conversion and aggregation source, not a security review.**
> Every entry in the index is third-party data republished from upstream. Nothing here
> audits, sandboxes, or endorses the plugins it lists. Installing a DSH plugin runs
> third-party code inside your harness; review the plugin's source before you install it.

## Status

Published and automated. The index URL above serves a live document, rebuilt daily by
[`build.yml`](.github/workflows/build.yml) and deployed only after the real
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` validator accepts it.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| TypeScript | compiles clean |
| Tests | Pass offline against fixtures recorded from the live catalog — `pnpm test` |
| Published index | Format 1, accepted by the real validator, rebuilt daily |
| Automation | daily cron, plus `workflow_dispatch` for a manual rebuild |

The exact plugin count is deliberately not quoted here: the pipeline reads the live
catalog, so it moves by a few entries between runs as upstream gains, loses, and re-pins
repositories. Query the index, or read the run summary in Actions, for today's number.
See [Running locally](#running-locally) to build it yourself.

## Run your own market

This repository is a template. Fork it, point it at a catalog, and it publishes your own
market at your own GitHub Pages URL, rebuilt daily — no server, and nothing hardcoded to
this account. **[Publishing your own plugin market →](FORKING.md)**

## What it produces

`dist/site/index.json` — a single format-1 document, published at
<https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json>. Additional **profiles** declared
in `config/config.yml` each produce their own document (for example a star-floor subset
published as its own market), and each is validated independently in CI.

Alongside it: **`stats.html`**, a statistics page generated from the same document.

> `dist/site/` is what gets published; `dist/` also holds the compiled JavaScript, which
> is not. The Pages artifact is the `dist/site/` directory alone, so the build output is
> not served as web content.

### What the statistics page shows

<https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/stats.html>

The market index answers "which plugins exist". The statistics page answers the different
question a visitor deciding whether to add this market actually has: how much of it is
measured, and how much of it is trustworthy. It shows:

- **Coverage**, each figure against its own denominator — how many entries carry a star
  count, a download count, a version history, an `engines.dsh` range, a category, a label,
  or a risk finding. A single "coverage %" would be a fabricated number here: stars are
  known for one subset of plugins and DSH ranges for a different one, and dividing both by
  the same total would invent a fact nobody measured.
- **Distributions** — versions per plugin, plugins per category, plugins per label.
- **Who uses this index** — repositories that mention or consume it, graded by evidence:
  *reads the JSON* (the published index URL appears there), *mentions only* (just the name
  appears), or a fork, which can publish a copy of its own. The tiers are never summed into
  one number, because a curated list linking to this repository does not consume the market.

  Two honest limits are stated on the page rather than left implied. GitHub Pages keeps no
  access log, so how many clients actually loaded the index is recorded nowhere — usage
  leaves no public trace. And GitHub's code search does not index every repository or every
  recent change, so the reference figures are floors, not totals.

Everything is computed at build time from the document that was just validated, so the page
cannot describe a market that differs from the published one, and the numbers are in the
HTML rather than behind a script. The page loads **no third-party script**; the only remote
hosts it references are this project's own.

### What the market declares

Format 1 lets a market publish its own curated vocabulary, and Discover renders all of
it. This market uses each axis:

| Axis | What is declared | What it gives you in Discover |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `metadata.categories` | Upstream's 23 categories, translated | The category pills above the list |
| `metadata.labels` | Permission capabilities, risk findings, popularity buckets | The **Labels** filter menu and the tags on each card |
| `metadata.sortKeys` | `stars`, `downloads`, `added` | **Sort** menu entries, each opening descending |
| `metadata.keywords` | Runtime identity, category, and capability words | Free-text search recall |

**Labels** are the most useful of the four, because they answer questions the upstream
catalog cannot. They come from three places:

- **Capabilities** — upstream's trust scan reports what each plugin's code can reach:
  `fs-read`, `fs-write`, `network`, `shell`, `env`, `credentials`, `llm`,
  `host-runtime`, `dynamic-code`, `subagent`. Filtering for `shell` finds every plugin
  that can run commands on your machine.
- **Risk findings**, normalised into five classes rather than the 86 raw sentences
  upstream publishes (most name a single domain or IP): `risk:credentials-and-network`
  (476 entries), `risk:plaintext-http` (97), `risk:literal-ip` (47),
  `risk:install-time-code` (22), and `risk:dynamic-code`.
- **Popularity buckets** — `stars:1k+` / `100+` / `10+` / `1+` / `0` and
  `downloads:10k+` / `1k+` / `100+` / `1+` / `0`.

Popularity is bucketed rather than exact, and that is a format constraint: a label id is
declared once and *referenced* by plugins, so there is no per-plugin label value. Exact
values would need 235 labels for stars and 1,690 for downloads, which turns the filter
menu into an unusable list. The exact numbers are still there where they matter — they
are the `stars` and `downloads` sort keys, and DSH hands them to the model through its
`plugin_market` tool.

### Sources

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Upstream catalog (the data) | <https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json> · [awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) |
| Version history (npm) | <https://registry.npmjs.org/> — one document per npm package |
| This converter (the code) | <https://github.com/hytime/dsh-discover-index> |
| Published index (what DSH reads) | <https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json> |

The index is a **conversion** of the upstream list, not an independent registry. Upstream
curates and hosts the catalog; this repository only converts it to format 1, checks it
against the real validator, and republishes it on a daily schedule. A bad entry should be
reported upstream; a bad *conversion* of a good entry belongs here.

### Version history

Upstream names exactly one version per entry. DSH's plugin page lists every version it can
install and refuses those the running DSH does not satisfy through `engines.dsh` — neither
of which means anything with a single version per plugin. The build therefore reads each
npm package's registry document and lists the versions that declare `dsh.bundle`, are not
deprecated,

plugins.description: Select text anywhere in a DSH conversation, attach a note to it, and send the whole annotation batch together with the next message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-annotations

[![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.1.7--rc.2-4D6BFE)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: select any text in the conversation,
write a note about it, and let the whole batch ride along with your next message
— for that one round only.

This repository carries the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic, which the DeepSeek Harness documentation requires of plugin repositories so they can be discovered; the link above is the inline, clickable form of that requirement.

## What it does

1. **Select → annotate.** Select text anywhere in the conversation (a reply, a
   tool card, your own message), and a floating **注释** button appears beside the
   selection. Click it, type the note, press **Enter**. Shift+Enter breaks the
   line, Escape cancels.
2. **Collect several.** Every saved note becomes a numbered marker at the left
   edge of the passage it is about — **hovering a marker shows that note** — and a
   **N 条注释** strip appears above the composer. Click the strip to open the
   pending batch, where each annotation shows its quoted passage and note with
   edit and delete actions. Clicking a marker opens that note's editor, with a
   delete button.
3. **Send together.** Your message gains one short **“💬 N 条注释”** bubble; the
   annotation text never appears in the conversation. **Hover that bubble** to see
   exactly which passages the batch quoted and what each note says. The list
   reaches the model as a system-prompt section, so the request still carries
   every quoted passage and note. The batch is consumed once and its markers stay
   in the transcript, dimmed.
4. **Send alone.** With an empty composer, the strip's send button starts a round
   from the annotations alone.

## How it works

The browser half owns the editing UI; the Host half owns delivery.

- The browser posts the complete batch to `/api/dsh-context-annotations`
  (a route registered through `ctx.connection.fetch`, behind the carrier's trust
  fence). It never writes into the draft.
- The Host keeps that batch per Session and listens on the `agent/pre-step`
  waterfall. `pre-step` hands over exactly the messages the step claimed — never
  replayed history — so a batch can only ride one round. When the step carries a
  `source.kind === "user"` message, the Host appends one extra message that holds
  only the marker (`💬 N 条注释`) and leaves the human message byte-for-byte
  unchanged.
- The annotation text does not travel in a message: `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`
  contributes it to the prompt, and the rendered prompt is logged as a hidden
  `system/message` node. The conversation therefore shows one short bubble while
  the request carries the full list; both are reconstructable from the log, and
  no plugin event type is invented.
- The marker message is written before the step records its messages, so it is
  part of an ordinary `user/message` record, and the prompt is likewise
  reconstructable from the log. By design, fork, resume and replay should
  reproduce the conversation the model saw; no plugin event type is invented.
- An empty composer cannot submit on its own, so the strip's send button writes a
  zero-width draft; that round is one empty human message plus the marker.
- The batch outlives only the turn it rode: `pre-step` marks it consumed (the
  browser then clears the strip) and that turn's `turn/end` retires it from the
  prompt, so a later round never inherits it. A batch that no round consumed is
  left pending instead — a note written while the model is still answering waits
  for your next message rather than vanishing with that turn.
- After a send the browser reconciles with one cheap request: the Host states
  `consumed` explicitly, which marks the local annotations sent (the strip
  collapses and the markers stay, dimmed). The same request adopts a still-pending
  batch after a page reload.

## What the conversation shows vs what the model receives

The conversation gains exactly one short message:

```
💬 2 条注释
```

The model receives the list as a system-prompt section:

```
1. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>

2. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>
```

## Files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: batch store, `/api/dsh-context-annotations`, `agent/pre-step` fold |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: selection button, note editor, numbered markers, composer strip and panel |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Insert the plugin row into the profile |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | Dependency-free test of the fold semantics and the browser bundle's registration |
| `test/client.mjs` | Regression test for the browser store: per-Session push, explicit consumption, editor identity, composer exclusion |

## Configuration

The bundle currently reads no configuration. The folded list carries no marker
line, so it reads as the user's own numbered notes rather than a plugin block.

## Install

Installed from this repository:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target="github:YubaiLoving/dsh-context-annotations"
```

Or from a local checkout of this directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  (target: this directory)
```

## Limits

- Markers key on character offsets into the flattened conversation text and are
  validated against the recorded passage; when that offset no longer matches (the
  content above the passage changed), a whitespace-insensitive passage search
  takes over, disambiguated by the passage's occurrence ordinal. There is no DOM
  path fallback. A passage that is re-rendered with different wording loses its
  marker; the note itself stays in the strip and is still sent. Markers that
  would land on the same box are nudged upwards so they do not stack.
- Annotations live in Host memory per Session. A Host restart drops a pending
  batch (the browser adopts only what the Host still holds).
- The float, strip, and panel read documented `data-*` markers of the shipped
  conversation shell (`[data-conversation-content]`, `[data-composer-seat]`,
  `[data-composer-card]`) and the browser's own selection. No other plugin's DOM
  is modified.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mt-mcp [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) ![DSH plugin 0.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH_plugin-0.1.0-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white) ![MCP Streamable HTTP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Streamable_HTTP-blueviolet?style=flat-square) ![deps 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/deps-0-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![MT Manager Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/MT_Manager-Android-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white) ![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square) ## 安装 ```bash # 从 npm 安装（推荐） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mt-mcp # 或从 GitHub 源码安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp ``` 桌面端把 `web` 换成 `desktop`。装完**重启 DSH**、刷新页面，进入 **设置 → MT 管理器** 填写手机地址即可。 连接手机上的 **MT 管理器**（[mt.cc](https://mt.cc)）与 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** · Connect **MT Manager** ([mt.cc](https://mt.cc)) on your Android phone to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. > 本页默认显示**简体中文**。英文版在下方折叠区，点开即在当前页面展开，不会跳转。 > > This page shows **简体中文** by default. The English version is collapsed below — expand it in place, without leaving this page.
English version（点击展开 / click to expand）
Connect **MT Manager** ([mt.cc](https://mt.cc)) on your Android phone to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. MT Manager ships an MCP server: start it on the phone and it becomes a **Streamable HTTP** MCP endpoint exposing phone files, APK, and ZIP capabilities. This plugin is the **desktop-side client** — a DSH plugin bundle that brings MT's tools into DSH sessions and adds a settings panel where the address can be changed at any time. Once connected, MT's capabilities appear as `mcp__mt__*` tools, so you can just ask in plain language: ``` Read test.txt in MT's Home folder and summarize it. Don't modify anything yet. Analyze the startup flow of the current APK and explain the relevant classes and methods. Pack the project folder in Home into project.zip at the archive root. ``` ### Why this exists DSH's built-in MCP client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) is configured through the composition: changing the endpoint means editing a profile patch file and restarting the Host. But a phone's LAN IP **changes** — DHCP lease renewal, a different Wi-Fi, a hotspot. This plugin moves "where to connect" out of configuration files and into the Web settings page: type the address, save, and it reconnects. No restart, no YAML. ### Install Requires a working DSH (`dsh web` opens the UI). **Compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and later** (`0.2.x`). The plugin has **no runtime third-party dependencies**: the MCP protocol is implemented in `lib/mcp-http.js` using Node's built-in `fetch`, and the only import is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`. Any install method works, and `pnpm install` is never needed. #### One-line install (recommended) ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp ``` Then **refresh the Web page once** — a newly installed client plugin has to be reloaded. "MT Manager" then appears in the settings sidebar. > Using a different profile? Replace `web`. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile is handled by the app itself and does not go through this command. > > `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm verbatim, so any pnpm-supported spec works. To pin a commit: > `dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp#` #### Install from the plugin market Add this index URL to the Plugins settings page, then install from the Discover tab: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp/main/market.json ``` #### Local development ```bash git clone https://github.com/aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp.git cd dsh-mt-mcp dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` No dependency install needed. Alternatively, have the Agent driving your session call `plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "")`. > If the plugin row reports `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` with a path pointing at a **previous** install location, the Host process cached the old module resolution — restart DSH. ### The panel ![The "MT Manager" panel in DSH settings](docs/settings-panel.png) Settings → MT Manager: enter the address and an optional token, then save to connect. The panel lists discovered tools and shows the config file path. > The image is drawn from the panel source's layout and sizing, to convey the information structure. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme (light/dark). ### Usage 1. On the phone: MT Manager → **sidebar → Tools → MCP Service → Start**. 2. Copy the address MT shows. DSH runs on your computer, so use the **LAN address**, e.g. `http://192.168.5.20:8787/mcp`. - The trailing `/mcp` is required; the default port is `8787`. - **Do not use `127.0.0.1`** — that points at the computer itself, not the phone. 3. In DSH: **Settings → MT Manager**, paste the address, then "Save and connect". 4. A green status line means connected, and the panel lists the discovered tools (measured: MT 2.26.x exposes **57**). #### The address changes; edit it any time Edit the address in the panel and save — **no DSH restart needed**. It reconnects immediately and replaces both the old connection and the registered tools. Set a **static IP / DHCP reservation** for the phone on your router to avoid editing it at all. #### Bearer token (optional) MT has authentication **off** by default: anyone who can reach the port can call it. Enable Bearer token auth under MT's **Settings → Authentication**, then paste the token into the panel's token field: - The token is created by MT; it is unrelated to any model API key. - Leaving the field empty keeps the current token; only "Clear token" removes it. - It is echoed only as `abcd****wxyz` — the full token never appears in any output. - Authentication does **not** encrypt HTTP. Use it on a trusted LAN only, and **never expose port 8787 to the internet**. ### What it can do The tools come from MT; this plugin only forwards them. Three groups by name: | Prefix | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `mcp__mt__mt_file_*` | Phone files: list directories, search by name/content/size/time, read and write text and bytes, move and delete, create directories | | `mcp__mt__mt_apk_*` | APK: open a workspace, analyze manifest/resources/smali/so, edit, rebuild and sign, manage workspaces | | `mcp__mt__mt_zip_*` | ZIP: browse, read entries, verify integrity, create, add/replace/delete entries, extract | Plus two helper tools from this plugin: | Tool | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `mt_mcp_status` | Show address, connection state, tool count, last error (never echoes the token) | | `mt_mcp_connect` | Reconnect using the saved address | #### The phone decides the access scope Which files are reachable is **entirely decided by MT's file access rules**; this plugin offers no bypass. The measured default is "the Home folder is read-write, everything else is denied": - Home defaults to `/storage/emulated/0/MT2/mcp` (changeable in MT's **Settings → General**). - To read outside Home, add a rule for that directory in MT's **Settings → Files**. - Files inside Home **cannot** be tightened to read-only; put files needing read-only protection outside Home and grant them individually. Only you can change these rules, on the phone. ### Disconnects and reconnects - On disconnect it retries with **1s → 2s → 4s … 30s** backoff, up to 10 attempts. After that, press "Reconnect" in the panel. - Android may kill MT in the background. Enable **floating ball** in MT's **Settings → General** and grant the overlay permission; this markedly improves survival. - Restarting MT's service or the phone changing IP will drop the connection. Edit the address and save, or press "Reconnect". - Phone and computer must be on the **same LAN**. Guest Wi-Fi, AP isolation, and VPNs can all prevent connection. ### Security boundary | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | Config storage | `~/.dsh/dsh-mt-mcp.json`, mode `0600` | | Settings routes | `/api/dsh-mt-mcp/*` accepts **loopback requests only** (verified via source IP, Host header, O

plugins.description: Cursor-like right sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, editor, Git, terminal, side chat and Ctrl+L references.
plugins.readme_text: # CursorLike Sidebar **让 DSH 对话与项目文件在同一工作区协作。** **Browse files, bring code into chat, and review agent edits inside DeepSeek Harness.** `dsh-cursorlike-sidebar` 是嵌入 DSH 原生右侧栏的工作区插件，提供文件浏览、代码编辑、Markdown 预览、Git 差异、原生终端、侧边对话与分屏，主题随 DSH 切换。 A workspace sidebar for DSH with a file browser, code editor, Markdown preview, Git diffs, native terminal, side chat, and split panes. It follows the DSH theme. 独立 DeepSeek Harness 插件，与 Cursor / Anysphere 无隶属关系。 An independent DeepSeek Harness plugin, unaffiliated with Cursor or Anysphere. [功能介绍 · Features](#features) · [安装 · Installation](#installation) · [快捷键 · Shortcuts](#shortcuts) · [更新日志](./CHANGELOG.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG_EN.md) ![在 DSH 中选中 Markdown 文本，通过 Ctrl+L 添加带行号的会话引用 / Add selected Markdown text to chat with Ctrl+L](./docs/screenshots/chat-reference.png) *实际使用截图：左侧对话、右侧 Markdown 预览，选中文字后添加带行号的引用。 / In-app screenshot: chat beside a Markdown preview, with selected text referenced by line number.* ## 功能介绍 · Features ### 1. 按习惯浏览文件 · Browse your way 同一个工作区支持三种视图，可从文件面板工具栏切换： - **桌面图标网格 / Icon grid**：默认视图，三列排列，首格返回上级。单击文件夹进入、单击文件打开，适合直观浏览。 - **树形列表 / File tree**：展开目录层级，查看项目结构，适合定位源码。 - **Miller 多列 / Miller columns**：逐级目录并排展开，适合在深层路径间浏览。 Switch between a default icon grid, a hierarchical file tree, and Miller columns without leaving the workspace. **桌面图标网格 / Icon grid** ![桌面图标网格 / Icon grid](./docs/screenshots/file-view-1.png) **树形列表 / File tree** ![树形列表 / File tree](./docs/screenshots/file-view-3.png) **Miller 多列 / Miller columns** ![Miller 多列 / Miller columns](./docs/screenshots/file-view-2.png) 右键可打开文件、新建 Tab、侧边打开、添加引用或复制路径。支持文件多选、复制/剪切/粘贴、重命名、删除及文件操作历史。网格中按住 `Ctrl` 滚轮可调整图标大小（24–160px），64px 以上的图片图标显示缩略图；树形视图支持 10–32px 图标缩放。 Use context menus and multi-selection to manage files, with clipboard operations and file operation history. Ctrl + mouse wheel adjusts icon size, with image thumbnails in larger grid sizes. ### 2. 把文件和选区带入对话 · Bring context into chat 选中文件或代码后按 **`Ctrl+L`**，即可把相关上下文添加到当前对话，减少复制路径、粘贴代码的步骤。 - 文件浏览器：选中文件后添加文件引用。 - 代码编辑器：选中代码后添加行范围；没有选区时添加当前行。 - Markdown 预览：选中文字后映射到源码行号，支持正文中的粗体、列表、行内代码。 - 拖放：将文件引用或选中代码拖入聊天输入区，也可把文件引用拖到文件面板打开。 Press **Ctrl+L** on a selected file, code selection, or Markdown preview text. References use a native `@file` chip with a line suffix such as `line 12-18`. With no editor selection, the current line is referenced. Drag files or selected code into chat for the same workflow. 引用格式示例：`@src/app.ts line 12-18`。Markdown 预览无法唯一定位源码时，会退化为文件引用并附上选中文字，保留必要上下文。 If a Markdown selection cannot be mapped uniquely to source lines, the reference includes the selected text as a fallback. ### 3. 隐藏无关文件 · Keep the file browser focused 在**工作区根目录**创建 `.ignore`，隐藏依赖、构建产物或日志。也可把文件或文件夹拖到工具栏的 **`.ignore` 眼睛图标**，自动追加规则并刷新。 Create a root-level `.ignore` to hide distracting files, or drag a file or folder onto the ignore icon to append a rule and refresh the browser. ```gitignore node_modules .cache *.log ``` ![在编辑器中配置工作区根目录 .ignore / Root-level .ignore configuration](./docs/screenshots/ignore-files.png) 规则使用 gitignore 风格的 glob，当前仅读取根目录 `.ignore`，不支持 `!` 反向选择。手动编辑后点击刷新。隐藏仅影响文件展示，不会删除文件，也不会释放磁盘空间。 Rules use gitignore-style globs. Only the workspace root file is read, and `!` negation is unsupported. Refresh after manual edits. Hiding files affects display only and does not delete them. ### 4. 逐块审查 Agent 修改 · Review agent edits by hunk ![轮次改动审阅：默认单栏、按块同意/不同意、上下跳转与撤销 / Turn review in unified view with per-block accept/reject, change navigation, and undo](./docs/screenshots/diff-round-review-unified.png) *实际使用截图：原生「第 N 轮改动」页按块审阅。工具栏显示「第 N/M 处修改 · 还剩 K 处」，提供 ↑ / ↓ 跳转、同意 / 不同意、全部同意 / 全部不同意和撤销操作（做出决定后可用）。 / In-app screenshot: block review on the native turn page — position, previous/next, accept/reject, bulk actions, and undo (enabled after a decision).* 原生「第 N 轮改动」页**默认单栏对比**，可手动切换左右分栏。连续改动行合并为一个更改块，每块只显示一组**同意 / 不同意**，也可**全部同意 / 全部不同意**。使用 **↑ / ↓** 跳到上一处或下一处，支持 Tab 聚焦按钮和恢复已保存的审阅决定。**Ctrl+K 同意、Ctrl+J 不同意、Ctrl+Z 撤销上一步**，快捷键直接显示在独立审阅工具栏中。待处理内容以红绿对比显示；同意后恢复普通背景、保留新内容并隐藏旧行，Ctrl+Z 后重新显示原始对比。撤销栈保存在本地，宿主重新挂载或刷新页面后仍可撤销上一步。窄面板中操作按钮移到块下方，避免挤压文字。 The native turn review opens in unified view, with split view available on demand. Consecutive changed lines form one block. Accepting a block shows ordinary file content and hides the removed side; Ctrl+Z restores its original comparison. The toolbar shows the current position, previous/next navigation, individual and bulk decisions, and undo; Ctrl+K accepts, Ctrl+J rejects, and Ctrl+Z undoes the last decision. Undo history survives host remounts and page refreshes. Narrow panes place block actions below the text. 手动切换左右分栏后，同一组块操作仍然可用： ![左右分栏改动审阅 / Split-view turn review](./docs/screenshots/diff-round-review.png) *左右分栏对比（手动切换）。 / Side-by-side comparison (manual switch).* Agent 修改当前打开的文件后，编辑器直接显示内联差异：新增或改写行标绿，旧内容以红色删除块显示。按改动块（hunk）逐个**保留 / Keep** 或**撤销 / Revert**，处理后自动跳到下一处，操作条显示进度，也可一次处理全部修改。 The editor highlights agent edits inline, with green additions and red deleted content. Keep or revert individual hunks, move automatically to the next change, or handle all changes at once. 「更改」页按连续更改块审查本轮 write/edit 操作：每块提供保留 / 撤销，处理后跳到下一处，一个文件处理完后切到下一个改动文件。只有能重建完整旧内容、且磁盘仍匹配该操作结果时才启用写回；否则显示只读 diff 与原因。**拒绝改动会立即写回磁盘。** The Changes tab groups consecutive changed lines into one review block. Keep or reject a block, move to the next change, and advance to the next file when finished. Ctrl+K accepts, Ctrl+J rejects, and Ctrl+Z undoes the last decision. Review requires a complete previous version and a matching current file; otherwise it stays read-only with an explanation. **Rejecting a change writes to disk immediately.** 未处理的编辑器审查状态按会话与文件保存在本地。重启后，文件仍匹配待审版本时恢复；处理完毕后清除。 Pending editor reviews are saved locally per session and file, and restored after restart when the file still matches the pending version. ### 5. 编辑、终端与分屏 · Edit, run, and compare 代码编辑、Markdown 预览、搜索、Git 差异、原生终端与侧边对话都可在 DSH 中使用。分屏便于并排查看文件和操作结果，减少在外部窗口间切换。 Use editing, previews, search, Git diffs, a native terminal, and side chat inside DSH. Split panes help keep files and results visible together. 安装 `dsh-diff-approval` 时，本插件还提供原生右侧栏 dock 集成与 Keep/Revert 快捷键转发。首次将其旧浮层迁到 dock 后，会保留用户显式改回 float 的选择。 Optional `dsh-diff-approval` integration docks its review panel in the native sidebar and forwards Keep/Revert shortcuts, while respecting a later explicit switch back to floating mode. ## 常用快捷键 · Shortcuts 快捷键随焦点生效：文件操作、文本编辑和 Diff 审查各自使用对应上下文。 Shortcuts act on the focused browser, editor, or review surface. - **`Ctrl+L`**：文件、选区或当前行添加到会话 / Add file, selection, or current line to chat. - **`Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+X` / `Ctrl+V`**：文件浏览器中复制、剪切、粘贴 / Copy, cut, and paste files in the browser. - **`Ctrl+Z`**：撤销当前上下文中的操作；审查时撤销上一步决定 / Undo in the active context, including the last review decision. - **`Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y`**：文件浏览器中重做 / Redo file browser operations. - **`F5`**：刷新文件浏览器 / Refresh the file browser. - **`Ctrl+K` / `Ctrl+J`**：同意 / 不同意当前改动块（编辑器、「更改」页、官方轮次审阅）/ Accept or reject the active block (editor, Changes tab, turn review). - **`Ctrl+Alt+K` / `Ctrl+Alt+J`**：全部同意 / 全部不同意当前审阅 / Accept or reject every remaining block in the active review. - **`Ctrl+滚轮 / mouse wheel`**：调整文件图标大小 / Resize file icons. 保留 DSH 原有 `Ctrl+B` 行为，无需额外桌面软件或 Python 运行时，不包含 PDF 依赖。 The plugin preserves DSH's existing Ctrl+B behavior and requires no additional desktop app or Python runtime. It does not bundle PDF dependencies. ## 安装 · Installation 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及兼容版本。安装前停用原版 `dsh-better-sidebar`，安装或更新后完全退出并重启 DSH。 Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or a compatible version. Disable the original `dsh-better-sidebar` before installing, then fully restart DSH after installation or updates. ### npm（推荐 · Recommended） 已发布版本：**`0.28.0-cursorlike.4-beta.1`**，当前 npm `latest` 指向此测试版。已验证可从 npm 下载；压缩包约 **4.97 MB**，解压约 **19.94 MB**（不含额外依赖）。 Published version: **`0.28.0-cursorlike.4-beta.1`**, currently tagged `latest`. Download verified; approximately **4.97 MB** compressed and **19.94 MB** unpacked, excluding additional dependencies. [npm 包页面 · Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar) · [下载当前
