# @dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold

[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.0.4-4d93f8)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/releases) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subagent-fold?color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-fold) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-subagent-fold?color=cb3837&label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-fold) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/total?color=2f6feb&label=release%20downloads)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/releases) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-BSD--3--Clause-8b5cf6)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/blob/master/LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-2f6feb)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的**子代理下拉折叠**：把子代理按「使用批次」收进 **历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次** 四组，**本次始终展开**，其余可折叠。

**不改原版头部、不新增入口**——只在官方「子代理」下拉里加分组，按钮和布局一个都没动。

## 怎么用

1. **打开**：点官方「子代理」按钮（原版也支持悬停展开，插件不干预）。
2. **看分组**：最下面是「本次 N」标签 + 本次批次（始终展开）；上面依次是「上次 N / 今日 N / 历史 N」。
3. **折叠**：点任一分组头即展开/收起，标题只显示「名称 + 条数」。
4. **子代理会话内同样生效**：打开某个子代理会话时，它头部的上级/目录下拉也按同一规则分组。
5. **删除子代理**：每行尾部有「⋯」→「删除子智能体」，二次确认后删除（运行中会先停止）。删除后该行隐藏，「N 个子智能体」计数同步减。

| 分组 | 含义 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| **本次** | 最近一次使用子代理产生的那一批（并行发起算同一批） | 始终展开 |
| **上次** | 上一次使用子代理产生的那一批 | 折叠 |
| **今日** | 今天其余批次 | 折叠 |
| **历史** | 今天之前 | 折叠 |

> 「批次」按子代理创建时间聚合，间隔 ≤ **120 秒**视为同一批。

## 效果示意

```
子代理下拉
├ 历史 12        ← 折叠（点开）
├ 今日 5         ← 折叠
├ 上次 2         ← 折叠
└ 本次 3         ← 标签 + 始终展开
   ├ 任务 A      运行中
   ├ 任务 B
   └ 任务 C
```

### 截图（前后对比）

| 之前（51 条平铺） | 之后（分组折叠） |
|---|---|
| ![之前：子代理下拉是 51 条平铺](docs/before.png) | ![之后：历史 13 / 上次 4 / 本次 4](docs/after.png) |

## 安装

### npm（推荐）

已发布到 npm，一条命令装进 profile（会写依赖与 bundles）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-fold
```

或手动：

```bash
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
pnpm add dsh-subagent-fold
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 登记：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-subagent-fold": "^0.0.3" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-subagent-fold"] } }
}
```

完成后**完全退出并重开** DSH。

### 最快（离线包）：跑安装脚本

解压后运行（自动写 `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`，并备份 profile 的 `package.json`）：

```bash
node tools/install.cjs --profile desktop          # 安装
node tools/install.cjs --dry-run                  # 只预览
node tools/install.cjs --uninstall --profile desktop  # 卸载
```

然后**完全退出并重开** DSH。

### 方式一：标准 bundle（推荐）

把本包放进目标 profile 并登记，然后**完全退出并重开** DSH：

```powershell
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>"
pnpm add "<本仓库路径或解压目录>"
```

在该 profile 的 `package.json` 登记：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold": "link:<本仓库路径>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold"] } }
}
```

### 方式二：手动解压

把 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`lib/` 放到
`<profile>/node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold/`，再按上面登记 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启。

### 卸载

从 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 移除本包，删除 `node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold`，重启。

## 兼容性

- DSH 桌面版（Electron）0.2.x，实测 0.2.1-rc.2。
- 纯客户端插件，**不依赖 super-injector 等热加载工具**；标准 bundle 安装即可用全部功能。
- 不采集数据、不发起网络请求。

## 文件结构

```
package.json        # 插件声明（bundle patch + client）
cordis.patch.yml    # 装配补丁：向组合树插入一条插件条目
lib/index.js        # 宿主半（空实现）
lib/client.js       # 客户端半：菜单分组与折叠（手写，零构建）
```

## 开发

`lib/client.js` 为手写 CJS bundle（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），无构建步骤。改完保存后 **Ctrl+R** 刷新页面即可加载。

## 已知限制

- 依赖官方下拉的 `role="tree" / role="treeitem"` 语义锚点；官方若改结构需适配。
- 折叠条插在原生菜单内，极端重渲染/虚拟化可能短暂移除，插件有 1s 兜底重挂。
- 悬停展开是官方行为，插件不拦截；点击开/关由插件处理。

## 许可

BSD-3-Clause

---

# @dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold (English)

[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.0.4-4d93f8)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/releases) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subagent-fold?color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-fold) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-subagent-fold?color=cb3837&label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-fold) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/total?color=2f6feb&label=release%20downloads)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/releases) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-BSD--3--Clause-8b5cf6)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold/blob/master/LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-2f6feb)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A **subagent-dropdown folding** plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). Subagents are grouped by **usage batch** into **History / Today / Previous / Current**; **Current is always expanded**, the rest are collapsible.

**No header replacement, no new entry point** — it only adds grouping inside the built-in **Subagent** dropdown.

## Usage

1. Open the built-in **Subagent** button (native hover-open is untouched).
2. The bottom shows a **"Current N"** label plus the current batch (always expanded); above it are **Previous N / Today N / History N**.
3. Click any group header to expand/collapse; headers show only "name + count".
4. **Also works inside a subagent session**: its header (parent/directory dropdown) is grouped the same way.
5. **Delete a subagent**: the trailing **⋯** on each row opens "Delete subagent" (confirmed twice; a running one is stopped first). The row disappears and the "N subagents" count decreases accordingly.

| Group | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **Current** | the most recent batch of subagents (parallel spawns = one batch) | always expanded |
| **Previous** | the batch before that | collapsed |
| **Today** | other batches from today | collapsed |
| **History** | anything before today | collapsed |

> A "batch" is clustered by creation time; a gap of ≤ **120 s** counts as the same batch.

## Screenshots

| Before (51 flat rows) | After (grouped & folded) |
|---|---|
| ![Before: a flat list of 51 subagents](docs/before.png) | ![After: History 13 / Previous 4 / Current 4](docs/after.png) |

## Install

### npm (recommended)

Published to npm — one command installs it into the profile (writes dependency + bundles):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-fold
```

Or manually:

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add dsh-subagent-fold
```

Then register in the profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-subagent-fold": "^0.0.3" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-subagent-fold"] } }
}
```

Fully quit and reopen DSH.

### Fastest (offline package): run the installer

After extracting, run (it writes `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles` and backs up the profile `package.json`):

```bash
node tools/install.cjs --profile desktop          # install
node tools/install.cjs --dry-run                  # preview only
node tools/install.cjs --uninstall --profile desktop  # uninstall
```

Then **fully quit and reopen** DSH.

### Standard bundle (recommended)

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>"
pnpm add "<path-or-extracted-dir>"
```

Then register in that profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold": "link:<path>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold"] } }
}
```

Fully quit and reopen DSH.

### Uninstall

Remove the package from `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, delete `node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-fold`, restart.

## Compatibility

- DSH desktop (Electron) 0.2.x (tested on 0.2.1-rc.2).
- Pure client plugin; **no hot-reload tool (super-injector) required**.
- No telemetry, no network requests.

## Layout

```
package.json        # manifest (bundle patch + client)
cordis.patch.yml    # assembly patch (inserts one entry)
lib/index.js        # host half (no-op)
lib/client.js       # client half: grouping & folding (hand-written, no build)
```

## Known limitations

- Relies on the built-in dropdown's `role="tree" / "treeitem"` semantics.
- The fold header is injected into the native

plugins.description: LAN session sync for DSH: auto-discover devices running this plugin, browse/pull/push sessions over HTTP with SHA-256 verification, and keep a local-only nickname per device. ｜ DSH 局域网会话同步：自动发现装了本插件的设备、仅存本机的设备命名、浏览/拉取/推送会话，带 SHA-256 校验。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-sync **LAN session sync for DSH.** Every DSH that has this plugin discovers the others on the local network, lists their sessions, and can pull or push conversations over plain HTTP. The nickname you give a device lives **only on your machine** — the peer can go offline, reboot, or change IP and come back, and you still see the name you gave it.
[![CI](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync)](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/stargazers) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4d6bfe)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) 🌏 [简体中文](./README_ZH.md) · **English**
![Session Sync panel](docs/preview.png) ![Planning a transfer: pick a folder, confirm every item](docs/preview-transfer.png) ## ✨ Features | | | |---|---| | **📡 Zero-config discovery**
UDP broadcast on every IPv4 interface with a 4s beacon. A peer that just appeared gets an immediate unicast reply, so new devices show up without waiting for the next round. | **🏷️ Local-only nicknames**
Stored in `/session-sync/state.json` and keyed by a stable **device id** (uuid) — not IP, not hostname. The peer renaming itself never overwrites your label. | | **🗂️ Browse · pull · push**
See each device's sessions with title, cwd and time; pull one into this machine or push one of yours out. Imported rows are marked as pulled. | **🔐 SHA-256 verification**
Exports carry `sha256 = SHA-256(JSON.stringify({format, session, events}))`; imports compare it **before writing a byte** and refuse with HTTP 409 `checksum-mismatch`. Each row has a *Verify* action. | | **🔁 Optional auto-pull**
Every 20s, pull sessions you have not pulled yet. Content fingerprints (not ids) stop two machines with auto-pull on from bouncing one conversation back and forth forever. | **🎨 Native look, i18n**
Built from DSH design tokens (colors, radii, type scale, 0.2s transitions), so light/dark follow the host. Language follows DSH by default, with explicit 中文 / English overrides. | | **🔎 Find sessions fast**
Search (press `/`), 全部 / 未拉取 / 已拉取 filters, sort by time or title, and ↑↓ / Space / Enter navigation. Rows stay quiet: one status chip, with 校验 and 拉取 on hover or focus. | **🧰 Tidy device cards & queue**
A per-device ⋯ menu (rename, copy LAN address, refresh, push, forget), transfers summarised in a bottom bar and a detail drawer, and network/advanced options folded away. | | **🪟 Master / detail**
Devices sit in a left column (session count + chevron, the whole row is the target) while the selected device's sessions stay visible on the right — no hidden "click a card to expand". The first online device is selected automatically. | **🧭 Per-device menu**
Push here, rename, copy address, refresh and remove live in each row's ⋯ menu; rename still happens inline. | | **🖱️ Drag, select, drop**
Select one or many sessions and drag them onto any known folder **or straight onto a workspace row in DSH's own sidebar**: the header takes the whole group, a session row takes the pointer's position and shows an insertion line between rows. Every drop asks for confirmation and names the workspace it will land in. | **🚦 Confirmed transfer queue**
Repeated pushes/pulls are detected up front; a dialog lets you keep the local copy, overwrite it, or drop that single item. The rest of the queue keeps running in order. | | **⚡ One-click sync**
**Sync all** / **Push all** plan the whole device in one go, skip sessions already present by content fingerprint, and report each row as done, skipped or failed. | **🌐 Cross-subnet scanning**
Broadcast stays on the local segment; add CIDRs, IPs or `ip:port` under *Cross-subnet scan*. CIDRs get silent UDP discovery packets, single IPs are also probed over HTTP on 47802–47817 — a firewall that drops UDP no longer hides the peer. | | **🚦 Queue that shows its work**
Each transfer is a card with spinner, measured duration, failure reason and a progress track; pulls stream their bytes so the card and the sticky bar show **live percentages**. The queue runs several workers sized from the CPU count (capped at 5), or a fixed 1–16 concurrency you choose. | ### Three UI promises - **“This device” is always the first row, and one IP is never two devices.** The card shows this machine's name, `LAN address:sync port` and running version. Any peer whose address belongs to this host is grouped underneath it as “other DSH instances on this machine” (browsable and pushable, so cross-profile sync still works) instead of counting as a device — the list and its counters only ever mean **other machines**. - **Untitled sessions carry `#first-8-chars-of-session-id`.** A pile of “Untitled” rows looks identical; the id is what tells them apart. The pull plan's “already present” flag is keyed by the same peer + session id, so renaming a session never turns a duplicate into a fresh copy. - **A crashing UI is never blank.** Render errors hit an error boundary that prints platform, Node version, host version, ports, UA and a stack summary, with *Reload* / *Copy diagnostics*. If Windows still shows nothing, paste that block into an issue. ## 🚀 Installation ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync ``` Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (the version bundled with the current desktop app) and Node 22+. Then restart the DSH desktop app (host-side changes load at boot; open pages pick up the new UI on refresh). The page footer shows the build that is actually running — if it reads an older number than the latest release, the process has not been restarted yet. The install is auto-activated: the package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles` on its own. Prebuilt tarball (no build step):
Manual install from a local checkout ```jsonc // ~/.dsh/profiles//package.json { "dependencies": { "dsh-session-sync": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-sync" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-session-sync"] } } } ``` ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/ && pnpm install ```
Confirm it loaded — the log shows: ```text [dsh-session-sync] ready: device , sync port 47802, discovery port 47801 [dsh-session-sync] discovered (192.168.1.7:47802) ``` ## 🧭 Where it lives A **Session Sync** row appears under **Plugins** in the left sidebar (`sidebar.panellist` + keyed `main` panel, id `session-sync`). The same component is also registered as **Settings → Session Sync** (`settings.section`). - **This machine** — the name other devices see; changing it broadcasts immediately. - **Devices** — online/offline, last heartbeat, session count, platform and version. - **Rename / Forget** — a per-device nickname for this machine only. Offline devices keep their row (and their nickname), greyed out. - **Sessions / Pull / Push** — list a peer's sessions, copy one here, or send one over. - **Verify** — re-fetch the peer's payload, recompute SHA-256 and compare it with the local copy (`sha256 2b12f7854d80… verified`). - **Integrity, not identity.** A digest proves the bytes match; it does not prove who sent them — anyone can recompute it. So verification stays automatic and fail-closed, and there is no per-transfer “confirm the hash” prompt (that only trains people to click through). When you genuinely need authenticity, copy the full digest and compare it out-of-band (phone, terminal); the copy action sits next to the verified row. - **Sync settings** — UI language, auto-pull, and manual peer addresses for networks where broadcast is blocked (`ip` or `ip:udpPort`, one per line). ## 🌏 UI language |

plugins.description: Region screenshot for the DeepSeek Harness composer: hides the DSH window, drag a rectangle over anything behind it, annotate, and drop the PNG into the composer. Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-screenshot

**Region screenshot for the DeepSeek Harness composer.**

One row in the composer's `+` menu. Click it, pick a mode, the DSH window steps aside, a
native selector covers the whole desktop, you drag a rectangle over the part you actually
wanted, annotate it, press the green tick — and the PNG lands in the composer as a
**pending attachment**, ready to send with your next message.

This repository ships **two packages**, one per platform, because the two native halves share
no code:

| Package | Platform | Selector | Route prefix |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`packages/windows`](packages/windows) — `dsh-screenshot` | Windows 10/11 | This plugin's own WinForms form over the whole virtual desktop | `/dsh-shot/*` |
| [`packages/macos`](packages/macos) — `dsh-screenshot-mac` | macOS | The system's own `screencapture -i` selector | `/dsh-shot-mac/*` |

Install only the one that matches the machine in front of you. Each package declares its own
`os` field, so installing the wrong one reports itself instead of failing quietly.

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

---

## What you get

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Composer `+` → **Screenshot** | The same two modes on every build |
| **Hide the window, then capture** | The window gives way — a shell hides, a browser minimises — and comes back afterwards |
| **Keep the window in the shot** | The client stays on screen and can be part of the crop |
| Drag on the frozen desktop | Selection rectangle, over the **whole** virtual screen at 1:1 |
| Drag a white grip | Resize the selection (8 grips, min 6×6) |
| Drag anywhere inside the frame (or the inner border strip) | Move the selection |
| `Ctrl`+drag inside the frame | Draw a rectangle annotation |
| `Ctrl+Z` / ↶ button | Undo the last mark |
| `Enter` / green ✓ | Accept and drop the PNG in the composer |
| `Esc` / red ✕ / right click | Cancel |

The chosen mode is remembered in `localStorage` (`dsh-screenshot.mode` on Windows,
`dsh-screenshot-mac.mode` on macOS).

Everything from *Drag on the frozen desktop* down to *Ctrl+Z* is the **Windows** selector's own
behaviour. On macOS the selection belongs entirely to Apple's UI — crosshair, magnifier, live
pixel readout, space to grab a whole window, `Esc` to cancel — and the plugin only takes the
finished region and puts the app back. This is deliberate: rebuilding that selector in AppKit
would only produce a worse copy of it.

## Which window gives way

Only "how does the client get out of the way" differs, because several kinds of host can be
showing this page and they can name their own window very differently. **This section is the
Windows judgement**; macOS is not given other apps' window titles by the system, so it uses the
one fact it does have — which app the click landed in — and that is covered under
"Platform and known limits".

On Windows there are three kinds of host:

| Host | How it is recognised | How it gives way |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Desktop build (page on `dsh-app://app`) | the page origin | **hide** |
| Any launcher wrapping the page in its own native window (Tauri, Electron, CEF, WebView2) | the window **owns an embedded webview child** (`WRY_WEBVIEW`, `Chrome_RenderWidgetHostHWND`, `Chrome_WidgetWin_0`, `CefBrowserWindow`, `WebViewHost`, `EdgeWebViewHost`) | **hide** |
| A real browser tab | its process is on the browser list | **minimise** |

Shells are recognised by **structure, not by process name**. The first cut only accepted the
names `dsh` / `dsh-x` / `dshx`, which covers exactly the launchers known at the time — and a name
proves nothing anyway, since any program can be called `dsh`. Now any window that owns an
embedded webview child counts, so a launcher nobody has heard of yet is covered too.

The reverse case is why "owns a webview" cannot stand alone: editors, chat clients and every other
Electron app own one for their own sake. Consoles (`powershell`, `pwsh`, `cmd`, `conhost`,
`windowsterminal`, …) and the OS shell (`explorer`, `dwm`, …) are always excluded, and a browser
is classified as a browser before anything else.

Both shells are hidden the same way, so a launcher needs no second code path — the only thing
that changes is how the window is *found*. A browser is minimised rather than hidden: a minimised
window keeps its taskbar button, the restore is the ordinary `SW_RESTORE`, and it lands back
where the user left it.

Recognition never rests on a caption alone:

- the click that starts a capture lands in the window showing the page, so **the foreground
  window is the first fact** — if it is a shell or a browser, that settles it;
- then the page title is matched against a caption (four characters or more, consoles excluded);
- then any **known browser process** (`chrome`, `msedge`, `firefox`, `brave`, `opera`,
  `vivaldi`, …), because a browser is the one host a native shell cannot be;
- only when nothing else is named do the shell candidates get ranked: a caption carrying the page
  title, then a process name that looks like this app's own (`dsh*`), and **more than one
  candidate left means nothing is touched** — guessing among unrelated windows would hide
  somebody's program, and a picture that includes the client is the better failure.

Anything else is left alone and the capture proceeds with the screen as it stands. That is a
deliberate trade: a picture that happens to include the client beats moving a window we could not
identify. When it happens the client logs one warning and the shot is still delivered.

Success is checked per mode — hidden must report `IsWindowVisible === false`, minimised must
report `IsIconic === true` — and the answer says which happened (`mode: "hide" | "minimize"`)
plus the handle it touched (`window`).

The desktop build is the one host the page can name outright, so the client sends
`host: "title"` there and `host: "auto"` everywhere else; `auto` resolves from the window
itself.

## Using it from the browser build

The host half is plain `webServer` + `connection`, so the web profile takes the same bundle:
add `"dsh-screenshot": "link:..."` to `<profile>/package.json`, list `"dsh-screenshot"` in
`dsh.profile.bundles`, junction `node_modules/dsh-screenshot`, restart. The capture runs in the
DSH host process on the machine, so a browser on another device can drive it — the pixels come
from the host's desktop, not from the client.

## Why the selection is native, not in the page

The picker used to be a DOM overlay. It could never be correct: a renderer's viewport is the
app window, so the overlay was confined to the window rectangle and the frozen desktop had to
be scaled down to fit inside it. You could only ever frame a region on a picture of the
screen, not on the screen.

A WinForms form parented to nothing, sized to `SystemInformation.VirtualScreen` and marked
topmost, covers every monitor at 1:1. That is where the framing, the eight grips, the move
strip and the annotation toolbar live now. The client half only hands the result over.

Two things follow, and both are deliberate:

- **The window is only away while you frame it.** The park/restore pair is a `try/finally`
  around the selector, so cancelling, timing out, or an exception all put DSH back.
- **One coordinate space.** Pointer positions, the crop and the saved PNG are all in real
  screen pixels, because there is no `object-fit: contain` scaling step to invert.

The handle is also written to a record file before the window is parked, and the driver's
restore-only mode (`-RestoreOnly` on Windows, `--restore-only` on macOS) can pull it back if
the process was killed outright.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11 or macOS.** Each platform has its own package, doing the same job different
  ways: `packages/windows` ships a WinForms form that covers the whole virtual desktop
  (`scripts\DshShot.cs` + `scripts\snip.ps1`), `packages/macos` ships a bash driver that
  opens the system's own `screencapture -i` selector (`scripts\snip-mac.sh`). There is no
  Linux path.
- A DSH desktop build whose composer exposes the `commandUi` service and the
  `webServer` + `connection` host services (the shipping desktop profile does).
- Windows: PowerShell 5.1,

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：每轮对话完成时弹出通知，标题为会话名、正文为回答摘要
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-turn-notifier

DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件。每轮对话正常结束时发送一条系统通知，标题为会话名称，正文为本轮回答的摘要，用于在对话执行期间处理其他事务时获知完成状态。

## 通知内容

| 字段 | 取值 |
|---|---|
| 标题 | 会话名称；会话尚无标题时使用配置项 `title` |
| 副标题 | `完成 · <耗时>` |
| 正文 | 本轮回答的摘要 |
| 图标 | 包内 `assets/whale.png` |

点击通知可激活应用窗口。

## 投递通道

插件按运行环境自动选择通道，两者不会同时投递。

| 通道 | 触发条件 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `client` | 页面处于运行状态 | 由页面内的 `Notification` 接口投递，以 DeepSeek Harness 自身身份显示，不需要额外的系统授权 |
| `native` | 页面未运行 | macOS 优先使用 `terminal-notifier`，不可用时回退 `osascript`；Linux 使用 `notify-send`；Windows 使用 PowerShell 的 WinRT toast |

页面以 2 秒间隔轮询宿主，轮询请求同时作为页面在线的心跳。宿主在每轮完成时将 `{会话名称, 耗时, 摘要}` 记录于内存，页面通过 `GET /dsh-turn-notifier/last.json?after=<seq>` 获取新事件，图标通过 `GET /dsh-turn-notifier/icon.png` 获取；两个路由均只接受回环地址的请求。

## 行为规则

- 仅在 `reason.kind === 'completed'` 时通知。用户中断、执行出错、策略拦截以及达到 max-tokens 的轮次均不通知。
- 默认跳过子代理会话（`header.origin === 'subagent'`），避免单次提问产生多条通知。
- 摘要取自本轮最后一段包含文本的 assistant 消息：移除 Markdown 标记、折叠空白，按 `summaryChars` 截断，并尽量在句末标点处结束。
- 通知投递失败仅记录宿主日志，不影响会话本身。

## 安装

`<profile>` 为 profile 名称：桌面应用通常为 `desktop`，命令行的 Web 组合通常为 `web`。

```sh
# 从 GitHub Release 安装
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "https://github.com/king-shao/dsh-turn-notifier/releases/latest/download/dsh-turn-notifier.tgz"

# 本地开发：链接源码目录
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "link:/path/to/dsh-turn-notifier"

# 本地构建产物
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "/path/to/dsh-turn-notifier-<version>.tgz"

# 已发布到 npm 时按包名安装
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-turn-notifier
```

`dsh plugin` 会将依赖写入 profile 的 `package.json`，并将 `dsh-turn-notifier` 加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；插件自身的 `cordis.patch.yml` 负责插入 Loader 条目。

注入行与路由均在宿主启动时注册，安装或升级后需要重启宿主。

## 配置

配置项位于 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 字段。

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 会话尚无标题时使用的通知标题 |
| `summaryChars` | `180` | 摘要长度上限，取值不小于 40 时生效 |
| `skipSubagents` | `true` | 是否跳过子代理会话 |
| `minSeconds` | `0` | 仅提醒耗时不低于该值的轮次 |
| `preferClient` | `true` | 页面在线时使用页面内通知，避免与原生通知重复 |
| `sound` | `Glass` | 原生通道提示音名称；`false` 为静音 |
| `icon` | `auto` | 通知图标：`auto` 使用包内图标，也可指定绝对路径，`false` 为不显示；旧名称 `contentImage` 仍可识别 |
| `activate` | `com.deepseek.dsh` | 点击原生通知时激活的应用 |
| `backend` | `auto` | `terminal-notifier`、`osascript` 或 `auto`；Windows 与 Linux 固定按平台选择 |
| `logFile` | `~/.dsh/turn-notifier.log` | 每次投递记录一行 JSON；空字符串表示关闭 |

## 平台支持

插件由纯 JavaScript 实现，不含原生依赖，各平台均可通过 `dsh plugin add` 安装，无需编译或额外运行时。桌面应用与 `dsh web`（浏览器）均支持页面内通知；在浏览器中首次使用时需授权通知权限。

| 平台 | 页面在线 | 页面未运行 | 图标 |
|---|---|---|---|
| macOS | 应用自身通知 | `terminal-notifier`（可选）→ `osascript` | `terminal-notifier` 与页面内通知显示图标，`osascript` 不显示 |
| Windows 10/11 | 应用自身 toast | PowerShell WinRT toast | `appLogoOverride` |
| Linux | 应用自身通知 | `notify-send` | `-i` 参数 |

macOS 上的 `terminal-notifier` 为可选增强项，提供更完整的排版、点击激活与图标；未安装时回退至 `osascript` 的纯文本横幅。

## 诊断

```sh
tail -n 5 ~/.dsh/turn-notifier.log                  # 每次投递记录一行，channel 字段标明通道
curl -s http://<host>:<port>/dsh-turn-notifier/last.json   # 最近一次完成事件
```

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-turn-notifier
```

随后从 profile 的 `package.json` 中移除 `dsh.profile.bundles` 内的 `dsh-turn-notifier`，并重启宿主。

## 打包与发布

```sh
npm pack       # 生成 dsh-turn-notifier-<version>.tgz
npm publish    # 发布前需将 package.json 的 name 改为自有名称或 scope
```

包内含：`lib/index.js`（宿主插件）、`assets/whale.png`（通知图标）、`cordis.patch.yml`（挂载声明）、`icon.svg`（插件管理器图标）、`locale/{zh,en}.json`（`meta.title` 与 `meta.description`）、`README.md`、`LICENSE`。

`package.json` 的 `exports` 暴露 `.`、`./package.json`、`./locale/*.json` 与 `./icon`；`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 patch 文件。

## 限制

- 原生通道依赖平台的通知服务与授权状态。未授予通知权限时，通知不会展示，仅记录日志；页面在线时不受此限制。
- Windows 原生通道借用 Windows PowerShell 的 AUMID 发送 toast，通知中心显示的应用名称为“Windows PowerShell”，而非 DeepSeek Harness。该通道要求 Windows 10/11 且存在 `powershell.exe`，缺失时尝试 `pwsh.exe`。
- Windows 不支持自定义提示音名称：`sound: false` 生成静音 toast，其他取值使用系统默认提示音。
- 页面轮询间隔为 2 秒，通知最多延迟约 2 秒。
- 宿主进程未运行时不会产生通知。

## 许可

MIT。通知图标取自 DeepSeek Harness 应用图标，属于 DeepSeek 品牌素材；再分发或公开发布前请自行确认授权范围。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：不关程序热重载插件与界面（类似 Ctrl+F5），或彻底结束程序并由独立重启器立即拉起。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reloader

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）**桌面版**用的一个小插件，只做两件事：

- **重载刷新** —— 不关程序。让宿主重新组合 profile（磁盘上改过的插件会被停掉、重新加载），然后刷新页面重新取数。代价：页面闪一下，设置面板会关掉。
- **自动重启** —— 彻底结束整个程序，再由一个独立的重启器立即把程序拉起来。代价：窗口消失约 5 秒，进行中的任务会中断。

入口：**设置 → 重载与重启**。

> 适用于打包版（Electron 桌面版）。源码模式跑 `dsh web` 时，「重载刷新」可用，「自动重启」会提示不支持。

## 为什么需要它

- 桌面版把窗口关闭当「隐藏到托盘」，`before-quit` 在有任务时还会弹确认框 —— 没有「礼貌退出」的程序入口。
- 插件装了 / 改了，DSH 默认要整个重启才生效；HMR 面世后可以只重载插件。
- 现在这两个动作都在设置页里，一键完成。

## 实现要点（改代码前先看）

```
index.js        宿主半端：路由 + HMR 重载 + 排程重启
client.js       界面半端：设置里的「重载与重启」页（自注册脚本，非 ESM）
lib/proc.mjs    认路（exe / app pid / host pid）+ 用 WMI 拉起重启器
lib/state.mjs   家目录、日志、事件台账（重启后还要能读到）
scripts/launch-restarter.ps1   用 Win32_Process.Create 创建「脱离进程树」的重启器
scripts/restart.ps1            等一会 → 校验 pid → 结束主进程 → 等宿主死透 → 重新拉起
selfcheck.mjs   自检（改完必跑）
```

### 1. HTTP 路由必须挂 `connection.fetch`

桌面版界面走 Electron 自定义协议，`ctx.webServer.register` 收不到请求。所以两条都挂：

- `/api/dsh-reloader/*` —— `ctx.connection.fetch.register`，桌面版与 Web 版都走这条（带鉴权）
- `/dsh-reloader/api/*` —— `ctx.webServer.register` 前缀路由，源码模式 / 老宿主用

前端启动时先探 `/ping`，哪个通就用哪个。

### 2. 重载 = `ctx.hmr.runExclusive(() => ctx.hmr.reconcileProfile())`

- 必须在 `runExclusive` 里跑（HMR 所有变更共用一条串行队列）
- 它会把「磁盘上文件变过的插件」停掉、重新 import、重新 apply
- 返回 `{ warnings, pending, restartReason }`：`pending` 是写了盘但要重启才生效的模块数
- ⚠️ 重载会**替换本插件自己**（文件变了就会换新实例），所以内存状态会被清零 —— 结果必须落盘到 `state.json`

### 3. 重启 = 杀 Electron 主进程 + 由「逃出 job object」的重启器重新拉起

链路上的三个事实：

1. 插件跑在 Host 子进程里（Electron 主进程 spawn 的）。`process.ppid` = 主进程 PID，`process.execPath` = 桌面版 exe。
2. Chromium 主进程带 **job object**（kill-on-close）：主进程一死，Host 与它 spawn 的普通子进程会被一起干掉。
3. 所以重启器**不能**是普通子进程 —— 用 `Win32_Process.Create` 创建，父进程是 `WmiPrvSE.exe`，既不在 job 里，也不会被 `taskkill /T` 顺着父链带走。

时序：

```
前端 POST /restart
  → 宿主 launch-restarter.ps1（WMI create，拿回重启器 PID）
  → 立即返回 { ok, restarterPid, delayMs }（前端进入倒计时）
  → 重启器睡 delayMs（默认 2500ms，让响应先落地）
  → 校验进程名是 DeepSeek*，taskkill /PID <主进程> /F（只杀主进程，不带 /T）
  → 等宿主 PID 消失（最多 10s），还活着才 taskkill /T /F
  → 等主进程消失 → Start-Process <exe>（失败退回 cmd start）
```

坑（都踩过）：

- `Win32_Process.Create` 的 CommandLine **第一个 token 必须是可执行文件**，否则返回 `9`（path not found）
- `Split-Path -LiteralPath X -Parent` 在 PowerShell 5.1 里是**冲突参数集**，返回 `$null`，会让 `Start-Process -WorkingDirectory` 报参数绑定错误 —— 用 `[System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName()`
- 主进程那一步**不能**带 `/T`，否则把还没起作用的进程树一起带走
- PowerShell 脚本保持**纯 ASCII**：cmd/PS 按 ANSI 读，中文会变成乱码命令；日志用 `-Encoding UTF8` 写（配 `tailLog` 去 BOM）

## 安装（desktop profile）

桌面版自带一套 dsh CLI，插件装进桌面版的 `desktop` profile：

```bash
# <安装目录> 里应是 DeepSeek Harness.exe
<安装目录>/resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add "link:<本仓库的绝对路径>"
```

装完 HMR 通常会**当场**把插件载入（不用重启）。没载入就点一次「重载刷新」，或手动重启。

> 也可以用 git 依赖的方式装：`add "https://github.com/kuroshio4396/dsh-reloader.git"`。

## 自检

```bash
node selfcheck.mjs
```

13 项：包字段、client 模块 id、cordis patch、`/api` 前缀、PowerShell 纯 ASCII、`restart.ps1` 不许对主进程用 `/T`……

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a live CNY cost estimate for the chat you are reading, priced with DeepSeek's peak / off-peak rates.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-cny-cost

**See what the chat you are reading has cost, in CNY, inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.**

A small badge sits under the composer next to the session statistics:

```
≈¥0.0123
```

- The number is the running total for **the chat you are looking at**; switching chats switches the number, and it grows as the chat works;
- Hovering (or a screen reader) reveals the breakdown: uncached input, cache-hit input, and output tokens, each with its own cost;
- It renders only while the selected provider is a DeepSeek official route, because third-party relays are not billed at DeepSeek's peak / off-peak rates.

## How it prices

It reads two projections the session already exposes and issues no requests of its own:

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Token usage | `tokenUsage` (`uncachedInputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `outputTokens`) |
| Current model | `modelSelection` |

Prices come from the official [Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) page (checked 2026-10), in CNY per million tokens:

| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | 0.04 | 2 | 8 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.30 | 9 | 27 |

Those are **peak** rates. Off-peak is half of peak; peak is Beijing time Monday–Friday (excluding Chinese statutory holidays) 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, and every other hour — weekends and holidays included — is off-peak.

- Cache writes are billed at the cache-miss input rate, matching DeepSeek's rule that there is no separate write fee;
- Legacy names `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are priced as Flash, per the official note;
- An unknown model name **hides the badge** instead of inventing a price.

## Known limits

- **An estimate, not an invoice.** It excludes per-request Search / Fetch charges; the official bill wins.
- **Chats that switched models** are priced with the currently selected model, because `tokenUsage` is a whole-chat total with no per-model split.
- **Holidays**: the built-in table covers 2026. A year without an entry falls back to weekends only, so its holiday weekdays would be priced as peak.
- Shown for DeepSeek official providers (`deepseek-official`, `deepseek-account`, or any new provider id starting with `deepseek`).

## Install

Desktop: **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter the **absolute path of this directory** (the installer records a `link:` dependency), then install and enable. Restart DSH completely if it asks, then refresh the page.

Command line, for a non-desktop profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-deepseek-cny-cost
```

## Develop

```bash
node --check client.js
node tools/test-cny-cost.mjs   # pricing, peak windows, formatting, slot registration, component behavior
```

`client.js` is the whole browser half: a lazy factory registered through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, with React supplied by the host module table. To make an edit take effect, remove the bundle and install it again from the same source (`ambiguous-install` otherwise).

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: 插件备份与恢复
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-backup [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Kirin-9000/dsh-plugin-backup?style=flat)](https://github.com/Kirin-9000/dsh-plugin-backup) DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的插件备份与恢复插件。DSH 更新有可能重置整个 `.dsh`——插件、配置、连同放在里面的备份一起消失。dsh-plugin-backup 把已安装插件清单持久化到 **`.dsh` 之外**的可配置目录，更新之后对比差异、勾选、一键恢复全部历史插件，不必逐个重新下载。 > 🛡️ **恢复只走 Harness 官方插件安装接口**（`pluginManager.installBundle` / `removeBundle` / `setBundleEnabled` / `setPluginEnabled`），安装动作必须由你在界面上确认后才执行；插件绝不代批安装脚本，也绝不凭版本号猜测安装来源。清单与日志只写本机磁盘，不上传任何位置。 ## 它解决什么问题 DSH 把已安装插件记录在 profile 目录里。一次 Harness 更新可能： - 清掉 profile 里装过的全部插件，逐个重找重装； - 插件还在但版本被悄悄换掉，行为和你说好的不一样； - 插件还在但被禁用，得一个个翻出来重新打开。 把插件清单备份到 `.dsh` 里解决不了问题——**备份和要被备份的东西在同一个篮子里**。这个插件做三件事： 1. **备份**：把当前 profile 已安装的插件（包名、精确版本、安装来源 spec、每个插件行的启用状态）写成可读 JSON，落在 profile 目录之外； 2. **检测**：Harness 更新后对比「备份 vs 当前」，列出五类差异： | 差异 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | `missing` | 备份里有，现在完全没装 | | `version-mismatch` | 装了，但版本和备份不同 | | `disabled` | 装了，但整个 bundle 被禁用 | | `row-disabled` | bundle 在，个别插件行被禁用 | | `row-missing` | 该插件行在当前 profile 里不存在 | 3. **恢复**：在界面上勾选后一键恢复，逐项执行、实时进度、失败记录日志后继续，不中断批次。 ## 安装 **方式一：dsh 命令行**（`web` 等 CLI 管理的 profile） ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Kirin-9000/dsh-plugin-backup.git ``` profile 不叫 `web` 就把名字换掉。重启或刷新后，打开 **设置 → 插件 → 「备份与恢复」**。 **方式二：官方 DSH Desktop 桌面端** 桌面端的 profile 归应用自己的插件管理器所有，应用运行期间命令行改不了它。请在应用自身的 **设置 → 插件** 里安装；或用方式三以开发方式接入。 **方式三：开发 / 本地接入** ```sh git clone https://github.com/Kirin-9000/dsh-plugin-backup.git # 把仓库链接进 profile 的 node_modules（Windows 需要管理员或开发者模式的符号链接权限） mklink /D "\profiles\\node_modules\dsh-plugin-backup" "<克隆路径>\dsh-plugin-backup" ``` 源码改动即时生效（Host 半侧由 HMR 感知，Client 半侧刷新页面即可），适合改代码验证。 ## 你会得到 - **启动自动备份**——DSH 启动约 5 秒后采集一次清单；清单没变且快照不足一天时自动跳过，避免刷屏。手动「立即备份」随时可用，快照按时间戳保留最多 20 份，超出自动清理最旧的。 - **一键恢复**——差异默认全选，可逐项勾选；恢复前二次确认，逐个插件执行并实时显示进度。幂等：每一步先读当前真实状态，已满足就跳过；`already-installed` 时按官方插件页同样的两步法（先移除再安装）。重复点恢复不会产生重复安装。 - **已备份的插件清单本体**——即使当前一切正常、没有任何差异，备份里到底有哪些插件、备份时什么版本、现在什么状态、几个插件行，一页看全。没有安装来源的插件明确标出「无安装来源，需手工安装」，而不是恢复时报一个误导性的 not-found。 - **备份位置可配置**——把备份目录指到 `.dsh` 之外的任意位置（本地盘、移动硬盘均可）；保存前真实写探测文件验证可写，不可写直接拒绝。位置指针双写（`.dsh` 正式记录 + 用户主目录镜像），`.dsh` 被重置后靠镜像找回目录（见下文）。 - **从任意 JSON 清单恢复**——不限于备份目录里的 `latest.json`：移动硬盘 / 网盘里的旧备份、自己手写的最小清单 `[{"name":..., "version":...}]` 都能直接按它恢复，且不改变当前备份位置。 - **系统原生文件对话框**——「选择文件…」打开的是熟悉的系统「打开」窗口：自由切换盘符、进「此电脑」、用收藏夹，默认只列 `.json`。非 Windows / 无 PowerShell 时自动退回内置的 `.json` 文件浏览器（子目录可进、面包屑可回跳）。 - **精确版本恢复**——注册表包钉到备份时的精确版本（`包名@版本`），保证「恢复成原来那份」而不是悄悄升到 latest；git / tarball / 本地目录来源按原样重装。 - **`plugin_backup` 智能体工具**——对 Agent 暴露只读的 `status`（位置 + 已备份清单 + 差异）与 `backup`（落一份新快照），支持可选参数 `file` 读指定清单。**恢复是安装包的动作，只保留为用户在界面上的显式操作**，工具不会安装任何东西。 - **完整日志**——每次备份、恢复、单项结果都追加在备份目录的 `log.jsonl`，界面可随时查看最近记录。 - **零依赖**——只用 Node 内置模块和宿主提供的 `pluginManager` / `webServer` / `tools` 服务，不 require 任何 Harness Client 包，降低 DSH 版本差异导致的加载失败风险。 ## 怎么用 安装后打开 **设置 → 插件 → 「备份与恢复」**，从上到下： | 区块 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 顶部 | 上次备份时间、插件数量、当前安装数量、备份目录；「立即备份」「刷新」 | | 备份存储位置 | 查看与切换备份目录（建议指到 `.dsh` 之外） | | 从指定 JSON 文件恢复 | 填路径或点「选择文件…」读取任意一份清单，按它恢复 | | 已备份的插件 | 快照里的完整插件清单：名称、备份版本、当前状态、行数、能否自动恢复 | | 检测到的差异 | 只有出问题的项，逐个带说明；勾选后「恢复所选」 | | 恢复进度 / 日志 | 实时进度、逐项成功/失败结果、最近日志 | ## 把备份放到 .dsh 之外（重要） 默认清单放在 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-backup/`。Harness 更新有可能重置整个 `.dsh`，所以**建议把备份目录指到别的地方**： 1. **界面**——「备份存储位置」→「更改位置」→ 填一个新目录（如 `D:\dsh-backups`）→「保存位置」； 2. **环境变量**——设 `DSH_PLUGIN_BACKUP_DIR=D:\dsh-backups` 后重启 DSH，优先级最高。 生效优先级：`DSH_PLUGIN_BACKUP_DIR` > `.dsh` 里的 settings.json > 主目录镜像 > 默认目录。 ### 位置指针本身也会被重置，所以存两份 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/plugin-backup/settings.json` | 正式记录 | | `~/.dsh-plugin-backup-location.json` | 主目录镜像，**`.dsh` 被重置后靠它找回目录** | 界面看到来源标为「自定义（靠主目录镜像找回）」时，说明 `.dsh` 被重置过：备份没丢，点一次「保存位置」把正式记录补回去即可。 ## 从指定 JSON 文件恢复 文件不必在备份目录里，名字也不必叫 `latest.json`。接受两种格式： - 标准快照 `{ "bundles": [ ... ] }`； - 直接一个插件数组 `[ { "name": "...", "version": "..." } ]`。 每条只需 `name`；`version` 决定重装到哪个版本，`source` 决定从哪儿装（缺 `source` 会标「无安装来源」）。选定后自动读取并预览（不落盘、不改设置），确认清单和差异后再「恢复所选」。坏文件（不存在 / 不是 JSON / 缺 `bundles` / 传了目录）都会明确报错，不会静默失败。 > **为什么不用 Harness 自带的选择器**：它的 `directoryPicker` 走 Win32 COM `IFileOpenDialog`，但把 options 硬编码成 `104`（`FOS_PICKFOLDERS | FORCEFILESYSTEM | PATHMUSTEXIST`），只能选文件夹。所以插件在独立 PowerShell 子进程里拉起同一个系统对话框（.NET `OpenFileDialog`）去掉 PICKFOLDERS，得到标准文件选择。脚本纯 ASCII + UTF-8 BOM（Windows PowerShell 5.1 的解析约束），选中的路径经 UTF-8 文件回传避免中文路径乱码。 ## 快照格式 ```json { "schemaVersion": 1, "createdAt": "2026-10-20T06:12:19.508Z", "dshVersion": "0.2.1-rc.2", "profile": "desktop", "bundles": [ { "name": "dsh-better-sidebar", "version": "0.28.0", "source": "dsh-better-sidebar@^0.28.0", "enabled": true, "rows": [ { "rowId": "better-sidebar", "moduleName": "dsh-better-sidebar", "entryId": "include:better-sidebar", "enabled": true } ] } ] } ``` - `schemaVersion` 变了说明字段结构有调整，读取方按版本兼容； - `source` 是 pnpm 记录的依赖值；`installTarget`（官方目录条目才有）优先于它； - 手动修清单后可以直接重新恢复——这是刻意设计的「用户可修正」通道。 ## 安全与边界 - **只用官方安装接口**，不做任何非官方注入；不记录、不上传任何数据，清单与日志只写本机磁盘； - **恢复必须用户确认**：Host 不会自行安装任何东西；确认界面列出全部将处理的插件； - **不代批安装脚本**：遇到 `pendingBuilds` 会停下来，提示你去「设置 → 插件」自行确认； - **没有安装来源就不猜**：`source` 缺失时不会凭版本号拼 `包名@版本` 去装——那会把本机自建 / 手工放置的包当成 npm 包，报出误导性的失败；这种情况明确提示交给你手工处理； - **不记录 DSH 安装自带的 bundle**（`availability: 'installation'`）：它们随 DSH 升级自己会回来； - **失败不中断**：任一项失败只记日志并继续下一项，结束给出成功 / 失败汇总； - **只写自己的文件**：备份目录、`.dsh/plugin-backup/settings.json`、`~/.dsh-plugin-backup-location.json`；不修改 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`； - **同源围栏**：HTTP 路由复用宿主自己的 `connection.requestRejection` 来源校验，任意网页无法触发本机插件安装。 ## HTTP 接口 浏览器半侧使用（都是同源 POST + JSON）： | 方法 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `status` | 位置信息 + 已备份清单 + 当前安装 + 差异 + 恢复进度 + 日志；可选 `{ sourceFile }` | | `backup` | 立即备份到当前目录 | | `restore` | 按勾选恢复；可选 `{ sourceFile }` 从指定清单恢复 | | `settings` | 无参读取位置；`{ backupDir }` 改位置（空串 = 恢复默认） | | `load-file` | 只读预览一份指定清单 `{ file }`，不落盘不改设置 | | `pick-file` | 拉起系统原生文件对话框选 `.json`；不支持时回 `unsupported` | | `list-files` | 列目录供内置浏览器用 `{ dir }`；只回 `.json` 文件与子目录 | | `log` | 最近日志 | ## 排障 | 现象 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | 差异里某插件没有「安装来源」 | 该条 `source` / `version` 都缺；手工装上后在界面点「立即备份」刷新清单 | | 恢复提示「安装脚本待批准」 | 去「设置 → 插件」批准该包的 build script，再回来重试 | | 恢复提示「与当前 DSH 版本不兼容」 | 该插件版本不支持当前 DSH；等插件更新，或在插件页显式授予版本豁免 | | 恢复后提示「重启后生效」 | `restart-required` 属正常：该包替换了已加载模块，重启 DSH 后生效 | | 想恢复某个已删掉的插件 | 快照里还留着它——只要没超过 20 份快照的保留窗口，勾上恢复即可 | | DSH 更新后面板显示默认目录 | `.dsh` 被重置过；若主目录镜像还在会显示「靠主目录镜像找回」，点一次「保存位置」补回正式记录 | ## 开发 ```text index.js 宿主半侧：清单采集 / 位置配置 / 差异计算 / 恢复编排 / HTTP 路由 / plugin_backup 工具 client.js 浏览器半侧：设置→插件里的「备份与恢复」页 cordis.patch.yml bundle 行声明（id: plugin-backup） locale/{en,zh}.json 插件列表里的标题与描述 icon.svg 插件图标 ``` 验证脚本（`node .tools/.mjs`）： | 脚本 | 覆盖 | | --- | --- | | `verify-host.mjs` | 宿主行为：备份 / 差异 / 恢复 / 两步法 / 改目录 / 指定文件 / 列目录 / 无 `.tmp` 残留，共 15 组 | | `verify-client.mjs` | 浏览器半侧：模块注册、字典、槽位、面板渲染、原生 / 兜底两条选文件路径 | | `verify-meta.mjs` | 展示元数据：locale / icon 可被宿主解析 | | `verify-live.mjs` | 真实快照与 profile 现状的一致性 | | `verify-external.mjs` | 外部目录 + `.dsh` 重置 + 指定文件恢复的端到端 | | `verify-browse-live.mjs` | 内置浏览器读真实备份目录时看到的项 | | `verify-script-ascii.mjs` | 原生对话框脚本纯 ASCII + BOM 编码约束 | | `verify-native-picker.mjs` | 真拉起系统文件对话框并自动选中（会弹窗，需桌面会话） | | `verify-contrast.mjs` | 按主题令牌真实取值计算按钮文字 WCAG 对比度 | > 测试全部把 `DSH_HOME` 与 `DSH_PLUGIN_BACKUP_MIRROR` 指向临时目录，不会碰你真实的 `~/.dsh` 和主目录指针。 ## 反馈 - Bug 与功能建议提 [issue](https://github.com/Kirin-9000/dsh-plugin-backup/issues)，附上备份目录里 `log.jsonl` 的相关片段能让排查快很多（注意先删掉其中的本地路径等敏感信息）。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE) © Kirin-9000

plugins.description: Editable canvases, rich messages, interactive UI, math plots and music inside DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# ChatCanvas for DeepSeek Harness

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[npm preview](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-chatcanvas/v/1.4.0-rc.13) · [Installation](docs/INSTALL.md) · [Plugin market](docs/PUBLICATION.md#add-the-market-source) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/issues)

**Turn AI conversations into a workspace you can edit, explore and play.**

ChatCanvas is a third-party plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It brings rich messages, editable canvases, interactive UI previews, math plots and music editing into the conversation.

## See it in action

Three short demonstrations, edited from real recordings. Play the videos below, or download their MP4 files. Waiting and typing are accelerated; the clips stop before subsequent AI replies. The interface shown is Simplified Chinese, with bilingual video captions.

### Write clearly · 21 seconds

Headings, quotes and colors; refine math notation and add a short instruction. The opening formatting example is a still screenshot, labeled in the video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b8679eac-9fc5-479a-9335-aa826f832c0c

[Download MP4](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/raw/refs/heads/main/media/demos/compose.mp4)

### Sketch your idea · 26.5 seconds

Insert a canvas and draw a layout directly in the composer, including a graph area, controls and annotations.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82bdbab1-b996-42c0-a54e-44af016d4413

[Download MP4](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/raw/refs/heads/main/media/demos/canvas.mp4)

### Edit the result · 24 seconds

Select and drag controls, adjust a result panel and reposition text in a UI draft.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5737babc-d01e-439c-95f1-6cfb779e6cde

[Download MP4](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/raw/refs/heads/main/media/demos/ui-editor.mp4)

[About these recordings and adding more demos](docs/DEMOS.md)

## What you can do

| Feature | In the conversation |
| --- | --- |
| Rich input and messages | Writing boxes, plain-text boxes, code highlighting, copying and native file references |
| Canvas | Draw, erase, arrange objects, snap to guides, control layers and share editable copies |
| Interactive UI | Build pages and controls, edit visual programs and try the result locally |
| Math | Explore functions, equations, parameters and 2D/3D plots |
| Music | Edit notes and tracks, audition instruments, import MIDI, export MIDI/WAV and transcribe WAV/MP3 locally |
| Visual questions | Let the AI show an editable draft and ask you to adjust it before proceeding |

<details>
<summary>Capability overview</summary>

![Capability overview — not an application screenshot](docs/assets/features.svg)

</details>

## Install

This is a **preview release**. Tested integration targets: DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2**. The installation helper is for Windows. Other host versions and operating systems have not been verified.

1. Fully quit Harness. If the old local ChatCanvas or combined renderer is installed, disable/remove it first; see [migration](docs/PUBLICATION.md#english).
2. Find the desktop app's bundled `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`.
3. Run `dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chatcanvas@1.4.0-rc.13` using that CLI's full path.
4. Reopen Harness. The plugin settings section is **对话画布 · ChatCanvas**.

The GitHub-generated **Source code** archive is for developers. It is not the compiled installation package. See [installation and rollback](docs/INSTALL.md).

**npm / Discover:** `dsh-chatcanvas@1.4.0-rc.13` is available on npm and in this repository's [third-party market source](docs/PUBLICATION.md#add-the-market-source). The downloaded npm archive has been checked against the reviewed prebuilt package. The older `1.4.0-rc.12` package remains in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/releases).

## Start using it

Write normally, or right-click the composer to insert content. Ask the AI to create a UI preview, math plot, music project or shared canvas. Use an editable copy when you want to modify an already-sent work.

Example prompts:

- “Create a two-page timer interface that I can try here.”
- “Plot y = a*x² and let me change a.”
- “Make a short piano melody and show the notes for editing.”
- “Show an editable layout draft and ask me to adjust it.”

The interface currently uses **Simplified Chinese**. This repository provides English and Chinese documentation. Full English UI localization is not included in this preview.

## Settings

Open **Settings → 对话画布 · ChatCanvas**. The public plugin exposes only two preferences:

| Preference | Default | How to change it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Program recommendations / 程序推荐选项 | 2 | Click the count, choose 0–5, then save |
| AI recommendations / AI 推荐选项 | 1 | Click the count, choose 0–5, then save |

Execution auditing, audit switches and tool/Skill whitelists are not part of this plugin. The host's permission controls remain available. Existing document and storage identifiers are retained for compatibility with older works.

## Permissions, privacy and cost

ChatCanvas does not register an execution-review gate or change the host's permission presets. Host permissions continue to apply. Canvas/UI editing and audio transcription use local code and packaged assets. AI text recommendations, translations, their quality checks and automatic conversation titles use the model configured in Harness and may incur extra usage. See [privacy and model usage](docs/PRIVACY.md).

## Preview limitations

- Audio transcription is an editable estimate; dense mixes and overlapping instruments can produce incorrect notes.
- Sampled playback is not a professional instrument library. Some instruments sound more convincing than others.
- UI simulation checks program logic; it does not replace visual testing.
- Long drawing sessions, high-DPI rendering and interactions with other plugins need further real-window testing.
- Normal Markdown tables remain supported. The old standalone enhanced-table editor is retired.

## Development

See [build and test instructions](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md), [integration](docs/INTEGRATION.md) and [document protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md).

## Feedback

Use the issue templates for bug reports and feature requests. Include the plugin version, Harness version, operating system and steps to reproduce. Share sanitized examples and screenshots. Avoid API keys and private conversations.

## License and credits

Plugin code: [MIT](LICENSE). Bundled assets retain their own licenses: TimGM6mb SoundFont is **GPL-2.0-only**; Basic Pitch and TensorFlow.js assets are **Apache-2.0**. See [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and bundled license/source material. The MIT label for plugin code does not relicense third-party assets.

This project is not an official DeepSeek product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. Upstream DeepSeek Harness components retain their original notices.

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for overriding the built-in HARNESS_IDENTITY prompt without modifying core files.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-identity-override

A DeepSeek Harness plugin with **two independently configurable system-prompt transforms**. Its configuration lives on DSH's **Plugins** page, without patching DSH core files:

1. **HARNESS_IDENTITY override:** replace the text of the built-in `harness:identity` section only.
2. **System-prompt keyword replacement:** find and replace text across **all assembled system-prompt sections**, case-insensitively, after the identity override.

## Install

For the default Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Soulize/dsh-identity-override#main"
```

If you use another profile, replace `web` with its name. If the plugin is already installed, update/reinstall its GitHub source through the DSH plugin manager so the new version and client UI are loaded; follow any restart prompt shown by DSH.

Open **Plugins → dsh-identity-override → identity-override → Configure** in Web/Desktop. The two features are on the same page and share one **Save** button. Edits are persisted in the current profile and take effect on subsequent prompt assemblies without remounting the plugin.

## 1. HARNESS_IDENTITY override

The default identity text is:

```text
You are a capable, task-oriented AI agent that proactively uses available tools, researches existing projects and proven solutions when relevant, and delivers correct and complete results.
```

The multiline editor supports custom text and literal `{{variable}}` sequences. **Use recommended default** restores the editor's original suggested identity; press **Save** to persist.

The identity override changes the text of the **existing** `harness:identity` section, retaining its position in the prompt. It never creates a second identity, overwrites `personaPrefix`, or modifies other sections. Keep the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` plugin enabled with `includeHarnessIdentity: true` if you want this feature active.

## 2. Case-insensitive keyword replacement

The second setting shows **two side-by-side text inputs** on desktop (stacked vertically on narrow screens):

| Left: Find (case-insensitive) | Right: Replace with |
| --- | --- |
| `DeepSeek harness` | `harness` |

With these values, every `DeepSeek Harness`, `deepseek harness`, `DEEPSEEK HARNESS`, etc. in system-prompt text becomes `harness`. All occurrences are replaced, not just the first. The rule is applied **after** the HARNESS_IDENTITY override, so it can also replace text in the configured identity.

- The rule is **disabled by default**. Leave **Find** empty to disable it; the text in **Replace with** is then ignored.
- Leave **Replace with** empty to **remove** matching text.
- Matching is **literal**, not regular-expression based. Characters such as `+`, `*`, `(`, `$`, and `.` have no special meaning.
- The official DSH prompt renderer expands prompt variables first, so a keyword also matches text originating from `{{model}}` or other registered prompt variables. Inserted replacement text containing `{{...}}` stays literal.
- The transform covers the **system-role prompt sections**, not the separately supplied tool JSON schemas or runtime-context user messages. Unmatched sections retain their original metadata and ordering. **Clear keyword rule** resets both editors; press **Save** to persist.

### Profile YAML

For a managed profile you can also configure the same fields directly:

```yaml
- id: identity-override
  config:
    identityText: >-
      You are a capable, task-oriented AI agent that proactively uses
      available tools, researches existing projects and proven solutions
      when relevant, and delivers correct and complete results.
    keywordFind: 'DeepSeek harness'
    keywordReplace: 'harness'
```

`identityText` uses the default text above when omitted. `keywordFind` and `keywordReplace` both default to empty strings.

## Behavior and limitations

- The Host uses the official `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall; it first edits the named identity section, then applies the keyword replacement across the assembled sections. These are **system-prompt text** transforms, not modifications to the model's tools or runtime context.
- Changes to each field are **volatile**. Once saved, new prompt assemblies read the values; a `system-prompt/change` notification is emitted. Requests already dispatched do not change.
- Disabling or uninstalling this plugin restores the original DSH behavior for future assemblies. No core file or system-prompt configuration row is modified.
- DSH's authoritative `complete: true` system-prompt mode can restore its complete section **after** the assembly waterfall. That upstream policy overrides both plugin transforms in such a scope; this plugin deliberately does not bypass DSH's complete-prompt enforcement.
- Matching is performed within each rendered prompt section; a search term spanning the blank-line separator between two different sections is not matched. Ordinary keywords and phrases are unaffected by this distinction.
- Changing the leading prompt text can reduce KV-cache reuse temporarily. After the configuration stops changing, cache behavior is again prefix-stable under DSH's normal rules.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1` with the official system-prompt service and Web plugin configuration UI.
- Node.js `>=22.19.0`, per DSH requirements.
- Runtime peer: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`, used for its official `renderPrompt` interpolation logic. DSH must make this package available to the external plugin.
- DSH is in developer preview; breaking changes to its plugin interfaces may require an update.
- The visual configuration panel requires the Web client module system and a managed profile. Headless profiles can set the YAML fields directly.

## Verify

1. Start a new agent step and inspect its assembled system prompt. Confirm the identity override appears exactly once.
2. Set **Find** to `DeepSeek harness` and **Replace with** to `harness`, then save. Inspect a new step's system prompt. Verify every occurrence in system-prompt text has changed regardless of case.
3. Confirm unrelated text, model-facing tool schemas, and runtime-context messages are unchanged.
4. Clear the keyword rule and save; then disable the plugin and confirm the standard DSH identity returns on subsequent assemblies.

Run the offline unit, Host-contract, and UI-contract tests:

```sh
npm run check
```

These tests use mocks for DSH and React. An end-to-end test in a running DSH instance is still necessary before claiming production compatibility.

## Design references

- [DSH system-prompt source](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/system-prompt/src/index.ts)
- [DSH prompt assembly API](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/system-prompt.md)
- [DSH Plugins configuration UI](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-plugin-manager/README.md)

MIT license.
